schema.name: search_abap_objects
schema.description: Search ABAP objects by name pattern. Wildcards: * ?. Custom code: prefix Z* or Y* (Z*ARTICLE*, not *ARTICLE*). Standard SAP: BAPI_*, CL_*, /SAP/*. MANDATORY before code generation: training data outdated - ALWAYS verify objects exist first, read signatures with get_abap_object_lines, then generate. Unverified code WILL fail at runtime. DISCOVERY ONLY - NEVER an existence check: the repository index retains stale entries for deleted objects and this tool keeps listing them (verified: deletes returned absenceVerified=true while three separate objects were still listed, one still listed 40 minutes later). It cannot distinguish a live object from a deleted one, so a hit here does not prove the object exists and a miss does not prove it is gone. To establish existence, read the object itself: get_abap_object_lines or get_abap_object_workspace_uri for source objects, and the matching read_* tool for DDIC objects (for example read_search_help).

MANDATORY before code generation: training data outdated - ALWAYS verify objects exist first, read signatures with get_abap_object_lines, then generate. Unverified code WILL fail at runtime. DISCOVERY ONLY - NEVER an existence check: the repository index retains stale entries for deleted objects and this tool keeps listing them (verified: deletes returned absenceVerified=true while three separate objects were still listed, one still listed 40 minutes later). It cannot distinguish a live object from a deleted one, so a hit here does not prove the object exists and a miss does not prove it is gone. To establish existence, read the object itself: get_abap_object_lines or get_abap_object_workspace_uri for source objects, and the matching read_* tool for DDIC objects (for example read_search_help).

DISCOVERY ONLY - NEVER an existence check: the repository index retains stale entries for deleted objects and this tool keeps listing them (verified: deletes returned absenceVerified=true while three separate objects were still listed, one still listed 40 minutes later). It cannot distinguish a live object from a deleted one, so a hit here does not prove the object exists and a miss does not prove it is gone. To establish existence, read the object itself: get_abap_object_lines or get_abap_object_workspace_uri for source objects, and the matching read_* tool for DDIC objects (for example read_search_help).

schema.name: read_abap_table
schema.description: Read a bounded single active transparent DDIC table with up to 1024 explicit columns or columns=["*"] for all fields, and structured AND filters. For compatibility with existing Classic BAdI diagnostics, tableName=SXCI is an explicit repository projection rather than a physical DDIC table: it exposes EXIT_NAME, IMP_NAME, CLASS_NAME, and INTER_NAME through read_classic_badi_definition, and an EXIT_NAME EQ filter uses an exact definition read. A confirmed DDIC_OBJECT_NOT_FOUND result for every other name fails as TABLE_QUERY_TABLE_NOT_FOUND and never falls through to an RFC reader. No joins, aggregates, paging, sorting, client override or writes. ADT first; only known empty HTML permits fingerprint-verified RFC readers. If the ADT dictionary endpoint itself is unavailable, a fingerprint-verified RFC metadata path is limited to explicit <=512-character projections and character/date/time fields; when the legacy reader cannot supply whole-layout metadata or reports DATA_BUFFER_EXCEEDED, the separately fingerprint-verified aligned reader is tried once. Authorization failures never retry, and an aligned-reader failure closes the path. columns=["*"], numeric, byte, deep and wide projections fail closed, and tableClassVerified=false makes the missing independent table-class proof explicit. Mixed flat layouts with ADT metadata support character, date, time and numeric text output; numeric values remain SAP strings without JavaScript precision loss. Filters and keys must be character-like; byte/deep projections are rejected, never omitted. Wide rows use <=512-character chunks joined by the entire DDIC primary key and two equal observations; changed/missing/duplicate rows or numeric overflow fail without partial data. Whole-row bounds and a 256-data-call budget apply; reduce maxRows if exceeded. Maximum 500 rows, ordering unspecified and snapshot=false. Authorization and SAP session client handling apply. tableName must be in the D5-2 allowlist (default deny); the allowed tables are ADMI_FILES, ADMI_RUN, AGR_1251, AGR_1252, AGR_PROF, AGR_TCODES, AGR_USERS, ALALERTDB, ARFCSSTATE, D010INC, DD01L, DD02L, DD03L, DD04L, DD07L, DD30L, DD30V, DD31S, DD31V, DD32P, DD32S, DD33S, DD33V, E070, E071, E07T, EDIDC, EDIDS, FPINTERFACE, FPINTERFACET, FPLAYOUT, FPLAYOUTT, SOST, STXH, STXL, STXSCHAR, STXSHEAD, STXSPARA, STXSTAB, SXCI, T000, T001, T001W, T002, T005, T005T, T006, T006A, TADIR, TBATG, TBTCO, TBTCP, TFDIR, TPFHT, TPFYPROPTY, TRFCQIN, TRFCQOUT, TRFCQSTATE, TSP01, TSP02, TSTC, TSTCT, USOBT, USOBT_C, USOBX, USOBX_C, UST04, UST10C, UST10S, VARID, VBHDR, ZTPMC_BZWL. Any other tableName fails as TABLE_NOT_ALLOWED before any SAP access, and the sensitive tables USR02, USR01, PA0001, PA0008, BSEG, CDHRS are never allowed. This bounded reader does not mean unrestricted native free-form querying is available.

schema.name: read_ddic_transparent_table
schema.description: Read one SAP Dictionary transparent table, including keys, delivery class, technical settings, package, concurrency version, and SHA-256 definition fingerprint. If the object has only a non-active version (for example left behind by an interrupted create), that stored version is returned instead with status 'inactive', active false, its own definitionFingerprint and a resumeTool hint, so the pending definition can be inspected rather than merely reported as blocking. Read-only and allowed for customer or standard objects. A read that completes and finds nothing answers with status "not-found", exists false and authoritative true instead of failing, so a missing object is distinguishable from a broken helper; every other failure is still reported as an error.

  "source": [
    "FUNCTION CRS_TBE31_MAINTAIN.",
    "*\"----------------------------------------------------------------------",
    "*\"*\"Lokale Schnittstelle:",
    "*\"       IMPORTING",
    "*\"             VALUE(I_CONSUMER) LIKE  CRMRFCPAR-CONSUMER OPTIONAL",
    "*\"       TABLES",
    "*\"              TI_CRMOBJAC STRUCTURE  CRMOBJAC",
    "*\"              TI_CRMEVOBJ STRUCTURE  CRMEVOBJ",
    "*\"              TO_MESSAGES STRUCTURE  BAPICRMMSG OPTIONAL",
    "*\"----------------------------------------------------------------------",
    "",
    "  DATA: LV_STATUS LIKE CRMPAROLTP-PARVAL1,",
    "        lv_status2 like CRM_PARA-STATUS_EXT,",
    "        lv_crmrfcpar like CRMrfcpar,",
    "        LT_CRMRFCPAR LIKE CRMRFCPAR OCCURS 0 WITH HEADER LINE,",
    "        LV_ACTIVE_CONS TYPE C.",
    "",
    "* note 412776",
    "  IF I_CONSUMER IS INITIAL.",
    "    LV_ACTIVE_CONS = SPACE.",
    "  ENDIF.",
    "* end note 412776",
    "*----------------------------------------------------------------------",
    "* check if TBE11 is maintained and active",
    "*----------------------------------------------------------------------",
    "  call function 'CRS_TBE11_ACTIVATE'.",
    "",
    "*----------------------------------------------------------------------",
    "* Handle active and inactive objects",
    "*----------------------------------------------------------------------",
    "",
    "  LOOP AT TI_CRMOBJAC.",
    "    LOOP AT TI_CRMEVOBJ WHERE OBJECT = TI_CRMOBJAC-OBJECT.",
    "      clear lv_crmrfcpar.",
    "      IF TI_CRMOBJAC-INACTIVE IS INITIAL AND",
    "         TI_CRMOBJAC-UPDKZ <> 'D'.",
    "* object is active, so write event to TBE31",
    "        CLEAR TBE31.",
    "        TBE31-EVENT = TI_CRMEVOBJ-EVENT.",
    "        IF TI_CRMEVOBJ-APPLK IS INITIAL.",
    "          TBE31-APPLK = 'BC-MID'.",
    "        ELSE.",
    "          TBE31-APPLK = TI_CRMEVOBJ-APPLK.",
    "        ENDIF.",
    "        TBE31-FUNCT = TI_CRMEVOBJ-FUNCT.",
    "        modify TBE31.",
    "* collect changes",
    "        IF SY-SUBRC = 0.",
    "* test if the parameter is set to inactive for object and consumer.",
    "* If so, it has to be reverted",
    "          CALL FUNCTION 'CRM0_READ_CRMRFCPAR'",
    "            EXPORTING",
    "              I_CONSUMER                         = I_CONSUMER",
    "              I_OBJNAME                          = TI_CRMOBJAC-OBJECT",
    "              I_DISCARD_DATA                     = 'X'",
    "                    I_ACTIVE_CONSUMERS_ONLY = LV_ACTIVE_CONS",
    "               TABLES",
    "                    T_CRMRFCPAR             = LT_CRMRFCPAR",
    "               EXCEPTIONS",
    "                    NO_ENTRY                = 1",
    "                    CONSUMER_NOT_ACTIVE     = 2",
    "                    OTHERS                  = 3.",
    "",
    "          lv_crmrfcpar-consumer = i_consumer.",
    "          lv_crmrfcpar-download = '*'.",
    "          case SY-SUBRC .",
    "            when 1.",
    "* The default entry should already be there. If not it is created during",
    "* initial download. At least there is no entry for an active object in",
    "* CRMRFCPAR",
    "            when 2.",
    "* No active Consumer though given. This might be an error!",
    "              TO_MESSAGES-MSG_TYPE = 'E'.",
    "              TO_MESSAGES-MSG_AREA = 'SMOF'.",
    "              TO_MESSAGES-MESSAGENO = '073'.",
    "              TO_MESSAGES-MESSAGE_V1 = SY-SYSID.",
    "              APPEND TO_MESSAGES.",
    "              exit.",
    "            when others.",
    "* There is an entry for an active object which is to be deleted",
    "              read table lt_crmrfcpar index 1.",
    "              LV_CRMRFCPAR-RFCDEST = LT_CRMRFCPAR-RFCDEST.",
    "              lv_crmrfcpar-objname = TI_CRMOBJAC-OBJECT.",
    "              LV_CRMRFCPAR-DOWNLOAD = 'D'.",
    "              CALL FUNCTION 'CRM0_WRITE_CRMRFCPAR'",
    "                   EXPORTING",
    "                        I_DELETE_MODE       = 'X'",
    "                        I_CRMRFCPAR         = lv_crmrfcpar",
    "                   EXCEPTIONS",
    "                        UPDATE_NOT_POSSIBLE = 1",
    "                        OTHERS              = 2.",
    "              IF SY-SUBRC <> 0.",
    "                rollback work.",
    "                exit.",
    "              ENDIF.",
    "              commit work.",
    "          ENDCASE.",
    "          MOVE-CORRESPONDING TI_CRMEVOBJ TO GT_CRMEVOBJ.",
    "          APPEND GT_CRMEVOBJ.",
    "",
    "        ENDIF.",
    "      ELSE.",
    "* Don't delete the entries but set the parameter 'DISCARDDAT' to",
    "* 'X' for this object and CONSUMER!",
    "* First read the general entry",
    "",
    "",
    "        CALL FUNCTION 'CRM0_READ_CRMRFCPAR'",
    "             EXPORTING",
    "                  I_CONSUMER          = I_CONSUMER",
    "                  I_OBJNAME           = '*'",
    "                  I_DISCARD_DATA      = SPACE",
    "                  I_ACTIVE_CONSUMERS_ONLY = LV_ACTIVE_CONS",
    "             TABLES",
    "                  T_CRMRFCPAR         = lt_crmrfcpar",
    "             EXCEPTIONS",
    "                  NO_ENTRY            = 1",
    "                  CONSUMER_NOT_ACTIVE = 2",
    "                  OTHERS              = 3.",
    "        IF NOT SY-SUBRC IS INITIAL.",
    "          CALL FUNCTION 'CRM0_READ_CRMRFCPAR'",
    "             EXPORTING",
    "                  I_CONSUMER          = I_CONSUMER",
    "                  I_OBJNAME           = TI_CRMOBJAC-OBJECT",
    "                  I_DISCARD_DATA      = SPACE",
    "                  I_ACTIVE_CONSUMERS_ONLY = LV_ACTIVE_CONS",
    "             TABLES",
    "                  T_CRMRFCPAR         = lt_crmrfcpar",
    "             EXCEPTIONS",
    "                  NO_ENTRY            = 1",
    "                  CONSUMER_NOT_ACTIVE = 2",
    "                  OTHERS              = 3.",
    "        ENDIF.",
    "        case sy-subrc.",
    "          when 0.",
    "            read table lt_crmrfcpar index 1.",
    "            lv_crmrfcpar-consumer = i_consumer.",
    "            lv_crmrfcpar-download = 'D'.",
    "            lv_crmrfcpar-objname = TI_CRMOBJAC-OBJECT.",
    "            lv_crmrfcpar-discarddat = 'X'.",
    "            lv_crmrfcpar-rfcdest = lt_crmrfcpar-rfcdest.",
    "            CALL FUNCTION 'CRM0_WRITE_CRMRFCPAR'",
    "                 EXPORTING",
    "                      I_CRMRFCPAR         = lv_crmrfcpar",
    "                 EXCEPTIONS",
    "                      UPDATE_NOT_POSSIBLE = 1",
    "                      OTHERS              = 2.",
    "            IF SY-SUBRC <> 0.",
    "              rollback work.",
    "              exit.",
    "            ENDIF.",
    "            commit work.",
    "            MOVE-CORRESPONDING TI_CRMEVOBJ TO GT_CRMEVOBJ.",
    "            APPEND GT_CRMEVOBJ.",
    "          when 1.",
    "            IF LV_ACTIVE_CONS IS INITIAL.",
    "              read table lt_crmrfcpar index 1.",
    "              lv_crmrfcpar-consumer = i_consumer.",
    "              lv_crmrfcpar-download = 'D'.",
    "              lv_crmrfcpar-objname = TI_CRMOBJAC-OBJECT.",
    "              lv_crmrfcpar-discarddat = 'X'.",
    "              lv_crmrfcpar-rfcdest = lt_crmrfcpar-rfcdest.",
    "              CALL FUNCTION 'CRM0_WRITE_CRMRFCPAR'",
    "                   EXPORTING",
    "                        I_CRMRFCPAR         = lv_crmrfcpar",
    "                   EXCEPTIONS",
    "                        UPDATE_NOT_POSSIBLE = 1",
    "                        OTHERS              = 2.",
    "              IF SY-SUBRC <> 0.",
    "*                ROLLBACK WORK.",
    "                exit.",
    "              ENDIF.",
    "              commit work.",
    "              MOVE-CORRESPONDING TI_CRMEVOBJ TO GT_CRMEVOBJ.",
    "              APPEND GT_CRMEVOBJ.",
    "            ELSE.",
    "* No general entry, so I can't get the data, especially for default",
    "* destination of this consumer",
    "            TO_MESSAGES-MSG_TYPE = 'E'.",
    "            TO_MESSAGES-MSG_AREA = 'SMOF'.",
    "            TO_MESSAGES-MESSAGENO = '074'.",
    "            TO_MESSAGES-MESSAGE_V1 = SY-SYSID.",
    "            APPEND TO_MESSAGES.",
    "            exit.",
    "            ENDIF.",
    "          when 2.",
    "* No active Consumer though given. This might be an error!",
    "            TO_MESSAGES-MSG_TYPE = 'E'.",
    "            TO_MESSAGES-MSG_AREA = 'SMOF'.",
    "            TO_MESSAGES-MESSAGENO = '073'.",
    "            TO_MESSAGES-MESSAGE_V1 = SY-SYSID.",
    "            APPEND TO_MESSAGES.",
    "            exit.",
    "",
    "        ENDcase.",
    "      ENDIF.",
    "    ENDLOOP.",
    "  ENDLOOP.",
    "",
    "ENDFUNCTION."
  ],
  "fingerprint": "6358d0120e1c9a0db262fc092119ad34e97add6132407e998798bc4a757d7818",

    "FUNCTION BF_FUNCTIONS_FIND .",
    "*\"----------------------------------------------------------------------",
    "*\"*\"Lokale Schnittstelle:",
    "*\"  IMPORTING",
    "*\"     VALUE(I_EVENT) LIKE  TBE01-EVENT",
    "*\"     VALUE(I_INTCA) LIKE  T005-INTCA OPTIONAL",
    "*\"     VALUE(I_APPLK) LIKE  TBE11-APPLK OPTIONAL",
    "*\"  TABLES",
    "*\"      T_FMRFC STRUCTURE  FMRFC",
    "*\"  EXCEPTIONS",
    "*\"      NOTHING_FOUND",
    "*\"----------------------------------------------------------------------",
    "  DATA: LAND LIKE T005-LAND1.",
    "  CLEAR T_FMRFC.",
    "  REFRESH T_FMRFC.",
    "  LAND = I_INTCA.",
    "  CALL FUNCTION 'BF_FUNCTIONS_READ'",
    "       EXPORTING",
    "            I_EVENT = I_EVENT",
    "            I_LAND  = LAND",
    "            I_APPLK = I_APPLK",
    "       IMPORTING",
    "            E_EMPTY = EMPTY",
    "       TABLES",
    "            T_FMSAP = FMSAPTAB",
    "            T_FMPRT = FMPRTTAB",
    "            T_FMCUS = FMCUSTAB.",

    "",
    "*---------- All function modules are collected in T_FMRFC --------------",

    "  AND NOT ( I_INTCA IS INITIAL AND I_APPLK IS INITIAL ).",
    "",
    "    IF   TBE01-XNASE = 'X'                                  \"Note 546391",

    "",

    "        COLLECT T_FMRFC.",

    "",

    "",
    "    LOOP AT FMPRTTAB WHERE EVENT = I_EVENT",
    "                     AND   ( APPLK = I_APPLK OR APPLK = SPACE )",
    "                     AND   ( LAND  = I_INTCA OR LAND  = SPACE ).",

{
  "connectionId": "w200",
  "functionName": "BF_FUNCTIONS_READ",
  "functionGroup": "ITSR",
  "shortText": "Determine Functions to be called for a given Event",
  "remoteMode": "",
  "updateTask": false,
  "updateTaskMode": "",
  "globalInterface": false,
  "remoteEnabled": false,
  "importParameters": [
    {
      "name": "I_EVENT",
      "typeName": "TBE01-EVENT",
      "optional": false,
      "passByValue": true,
      "description": "Business Event"
    },
    {
      "name": "I_LAND",
      "typeName": "T005-LAND1",
      "optional": true,
      "passByValue": true,
      "description": "Country Key"
    },
    {
      "name": "I_APPLK",
      "typeName": "TBE11-APPLK",
      "optional": true,
      "passByValue": true,
      "description": "Application Indicator"
    },
    {
      "name": "I_NO_XLBSE",
      "typeName": "BOOLE-BOOLE",
      "optional": true,
      "passByValue": true,
      "description": ""
    }
  ],
  "exportParameters": [
    {
      "name": "E_EMPTY",
      "typeName": "BOOLE-BOOLE",
      "optional": false,
      "passByValue": true,
      "description": ""
    }
  ],
  "changingParameters": [],
  "tableParameters": [
    {
      "name": "T_FMSAP",
      "typeName": "FMSAP",
      "optional": false,
      "passByValue": false,
      "description": "Table of SAP Modules to be Called"
    },
    {
      "name": "T_FMPRT",
      "typeName": "FMPRT",
      "optional": false,
      "passByValue": false,
      "description": "Table of Partner Modules to be Called"
    },
    {
      "name": "T_FMCUS",
      "typeName": "FMCUS",
      "optional": false,
      "passByValue": false,
      "description": "Table of Customer Modules to be Called"
    }
  ],
  "exceptions": [],
  "source": [
    "FUNCTION BF_FUNCTIONS_READ .",
    "*\"----------------------------------------------------------------------",
    "*\"*\"Lokale Schnittstelle:",
    "*\"  IMPORTING",
    "*\"     VALUE(I_EVENT) LIKE  TBE01-EVENT",
    "*\"     VALUE(I_LAND) LIKE  T005-LAND1 OPTIONAL",
    "*\"     VALUE(I_APPLK) LIKE  TBE11-APPLK OPTIONAL",
    "*\"     VALUE(I_NO_XLBSE) LIKE  BOOLE-BOOLE OPTIONAL",
    "*\"  EXPORTING",
    "*\"     VALUE(E_EMPTY) LIKE  BOOLE-BOOLE",
    "*\"  TABLES",
    "*\"      T_FMSAP STRUCTURE  FMSAP",
    "*\"      T_FMPRT STRUCTURE  FMPRT",
    "*\"      T_FMCUS STRUCTURE  FMCUS",
    "*\"----------------------------------------------------------------------",
    "",
    "  CHECK NOT I_EVENT IS INITIAL.",
    "  XNOXLBSE = I_NO_XLBSE.",
    "  CLEAR E_EMPTY.",
    "",
    "*-------------- Data for this event already there ? --------------------",
    "  READ TABLE EVSTATUS WITH KEY EVENT = I_EVENT",
    "                               LAND  = I_LAND",
    "                               APPLK = I_APPLK.",
    "  IF SY-SUBRC = 0 AND EVSTATUS-CHCKD = 'X'.",
    "",
    "*----------- Supply tables from buffered data and exit -----------------",
    "    T_FMSAP[] = FMSAPTAB[].",
    "    T_FMPRT[] = FMPRTTAB[].",
    "    T_FMCUS[] = FMCUSTAB[].",
    "    E_EMPTY = EVSTATUS-EMPTY.",
    "    EXIT.",
    "  ELSE.",
    "    RCODE = 0.",
    "    PERFORM TBE01_READ USING I_EVENT RCODE.",
    "",
    "*------------- Event not in table --------------------------------------",
    "    IF RCODE = 4.",
    "      E_EMPTY = 'X'.",
    "      T_FMSAP[] = FMSAPTAB[].",
    "      T_FMPRT[] = FMPRTTAB[].",
    "      T_FMCUS[] = FMCUSTAB[].",
    "      EXIT.",
    "    ENDIF.",
    "    IF TBE01-XLBSE IS INITIAL.",
    "      PERFORM TABLE_FILL USING I_EVENT SPACE SPACE SPACE SPACE",
    "                         CHANGING E_EMPTY.",
    "    ELSE.",
    "      PERFORM TABLE_FILL USING I_EVENT I_LAND I_APPLK 'X' TBE01-XNASE",
    "                         CHANGING E_EMPTY.",
    "    ENDIF.",
    "  ENDIF.",
    "",
    "*----------------- Information for buffer ------------------------------",
    "  PERFORM EVSTATUS_MODIFY USING    I_EVENT I_LAND I_APPLK E_EMPTY.",
    "",
    "*----------------- Supply tables ---------------------------------------",

    "FUNCTION open_fi_perform_00000900_e .",

    "*\"  TABLES",
    "*\"      T_BKPF STRUCTURE  BKPF",
    "*\"      T_POSTAB STRUCTURE  RFOPS",
    "*\"  EXCEPTIONS",
    "*\"      NOTHING_ACTIVE",
    "*\"      WRONG_SUBST",
    "*\"----------------------------------------------------------------------",
    "  DATA: l_bkpf   TYPE TABLE OF bkpf,",
    "        l_postab   TYPE TABLE OF rfops,",
    "        l_postabsub TYPE TABLE OF rfops_s,",
    "        s_pos_sub   TYPE rfops_s,",
    "        l_lines TYPE sytfill,",
    "        t_lines TYPE sytfill.",
    "  FIELD-SYMBOLS: <pos> TYPE rfops.",
    "  CALL FUNCTION 'BF_FUNCTIONS_FIND'",
    "    EXPORTING",
    "      i_event       = '00000900'",
    "    TABLES",
    "      t_fmrfc       = fmtab",
    "    EXCEPTIONS",
    "      nothing_found = 4",
    "      OTHERS        = 8.",
    "  IF sy-subrc NE 0.",
    "    MESSAGE s015 WITH '00000900' RAISING nothing_active.",
    "  ENDIF.",
    "*------------------ Save interface data --------------------------------",
    "  l_bkpf[]  = t_bkpf[].",
    "",
    "  LOOP AT fmtab.",
    "    l_postab[]  = t_postab[].",
    "    CHECK NOT fmtab-funct IS INITIAL.",
    "* refresh int. table if filled from previous call",
    "    if l_lines > 0.",
    "      REFRESH l_postabsub.",
    "    endif.",
    "    IF fmtab-rfcds IS INITIAL.",
    "",
    "*------------- Open FI Interface with local destination ----------------",
    "      CALL FUNCTION fmtab-funct",
    "        EXPORTING",
    "          I_RF05A     = I_RF05A",
    "        TABLES",
    "          t_bkpf      = l_bkpf",
    "          t_postab    = l_postab",
    "          t_postabsub = l_postabsub.",
    "    ELSE.",
    "*------------- Open FI Interface with foreign destination --------------",
    "      CALL FUNCTION fmtab-funct",
    "        DESTINATION fmtab-rfcds",
    "        EXPORTING",
    "          I_RF05A               = I_RF05A",
    "        TABLES",
    "          t_bkpf                = l_bkpf",
    "          t_postab              = l_postab",
    "          t_postabsub           = l_postabsub",
    "        EXCEPTIONS",
    "          communication_failure = 1",
    "          system_failure        = 2.",
    "      IF sy-subrc NE 0.",
    "        MESSAGE e011 WITH fmtab-rfcds.",
    "      ENDIF.",
    "    ENDIF.",
    "* copy data in loop if multiple components are assigned to event",
    "*------- Check if number of lines was not changed ----------------------",
    "    DESCRIBE TABLE l_postabsub LINES l_lines.",
    "    DESCRIBE TABLE t_postab    LINES t_lines.",
    "    IF l_lines > t_lines.",
    "      MESSAGE e018 RAISING wrong_subst.",
    "    ELSEIF l_lines > 0.",
    "      refresh l_postab.",
    "      LOOP AT l_postabsub INTO s_pos_sub.",
    "        CHECK s_pos_sub-tabix GE 1 AND s_pos_sub-tabix LE t_lines.",
    "        READ TABLE t_postab INDEX s_pos_sub-tabix ASSIGNING <pos>.",
    "        MOVE-CORRESPONDING s_pos_sub TO <pos>.",
    "      ENDLOOP.",
    "    ENDIF.",
    "  ENDLOOP.",
    "*------- Check if number of lines was not changed ----------------------",
    "ENDFUNCTION."

schema.name: search_abap_objects
schema.description: Search ABAP objects by name pattern. Wildcards: * ?. Custom code: prefix Z* or Y* (Z*ARTICLE*, not *ARTICLE*). Standard SAP: BAPI_*, CL_*, /SAP/*. MANDATORY before code generation: training data outdated - ALWAYS verify objects exist first, read signatures with get_abap_object_lines, then generate. Unverified code WILL fail at runtime. DISCOVERY ONLY - NEVER an existence check: the repository index retains stale entries for deleted objects and this tool keeps listing them (verified: deletes returned absenceVerified=true while three separate objects were still listed, one still listed 40 minutes later). It cannot distinguish a live object from a deleted one, so a hit here does not prove the object exists and a miss does not prove it is gone. To establish existence, read the object itself: get_abap_object_lines or get_abap_object_workspace_uri for source objects, and the matching read_* tool for DDIC objects (for example read_search_help).

    "          neuer_eintrag TO upd_trans_patt+2,",
    "          aendern TO upd_trans_patt+3,",
    "          original TO del_trans_patt, geloescht TO del_trans_patt+1,",
    "          aendern  TO del_trans_patt+2,",
    "          update_geloescht TO del_trans_patt+3,",
    "          neuer_eintrag TO del_trans_patt+4,",
    "          neuer_geloescht TO del_trans_patt+5.",
    "    REFRESH extract.",
    "    SORT ix_to_modify BY tot_index.",
    "    LOOP AT ix_to_modify WHERE action NE 'TIN' AND action NE 'TEX'.",
    "      SUBTRACT nbr_of_del FROM ix_to_modify-tot_index.",
    "      READ TABLE total INTO extract INDEX ix_to_modify-tot_index.",
    "      CASE ix_to_modify-action.",
    "        WHEN 'INS'.",
    "          <x_action> = neuer_eintrag.  \"ignore wrong flags of new entry",
    "          DELETE total INDEX ix_to_modify-tot_index.",
    "          ADD 1 TO nbr_of_del.",
    "        WHEN 'COP'.",
    "          <x_action> = kopieren.       \"ignore wrong flags of new entry",
    "          DELETE total INDEX ix_to_modify-tot_index.",
    "          ADD 1 TO nbr_of_del.",
    "          APPEND extract.              \"destination",
    "          READ TABLE total INTO extract INDEX ix_to_modify-org_tot_ix.",
    "          <x_action> = vim_source_entry. \"source",
    "        WHEN 'UPD'.",
    "          TRANSLATE <x_action> USING upd_trans_patt.",
    "        WHEN 'UPI'.                                         \"SW",
    "          DELETE total INDEX ix_to_modify-tot_index.",
    "          ADD 1 TO nbr_of_del.",
    "          TRANSLATE <x_action> USING upd_trans_patt.",
    "        WHEN 'UDL'.",
    "          TRANSLATE: <x_action> USING udl_trans_patt.",
    "        WHEN 'DEL'.",
    "          TRANSLATE: <x_action> USING del_trans_patt.",
    "        WHEN 'DEI'.                                         \"MF",
    "          DELETE total INDEX ix_to_modify-tot_index.",
    "          ADD 1 TO nbr_of_del.",
    "          TRANSLATE: <x_action> USING del_trans_patt.",
    "        WHEN 'TIN'.",
    "          <x_action> = task_add.",
    "        WHEN 'TEX'.",
    "          <x_action> = task_del.",
    "      ENDCASE.",
    "      APPEND extract.",
    "    ENDLOOP.",
    "    IF sy-subrc EQ 0.",
    "      IF import_mode EQ space.",
    "        CALL FUNCTION 'VIEW_MAINTENANCE_LOW_LEVEL'",
    "             EXPORTING",
    "                  corr_number                 = corr_number",
    "                  fcode                       = 'EXED'",
    "                  view_action                 = 'U'",
    "                  view_name                   = view_name",
    "                  complex_selconds_used       = complex_selconds_used",
    "               rfc_destination_for_upgrade = rfc_destination_for_upgrade",
    "             IMPORTING",
    "                  update_required             = update_required",
    "             TABLES",
    "                  corr_keytab                 = corr_keytab",
    "                  dba_sellist                 = dba_sellist",
    "                  dpl_sellist                 = dpl_sellist",
    "                  excl_cua_funct              = dummy_tab",
    "                  extract                     = extract",
    "                  total                       = total",
    "                  x_header                    = x_header",
    "                  x_namtab                    = x_namtab",
    "             EXCEPTIONS",
    "                  missing_corr_number         = 1.",
    "        fb_rc = sy-subrc.",
    "        IF fb_rc EQ 0.",
    "          PERFORM vim_get_global_field_value IN PROGRAM (fpool_name)",
    "                                      USING 'VIM_RESULTS_OF_EXT_MOD'",
    "                                            'VIMMODRES' results h_lg.",
    "        ENDIF.",
    "      ELSE.                            \"import mode activ",
    "        PERFORM x_call_viewmaintenance IN PROGRAM (fpool_name)",
    "                            USING i_uselcltbl",
    "                                    import_mode corr_number 'EXED' 'U'",
    "                                    view_name tot_name ext_name",
    "                                    rfc_destination_for_upgrade",
    "                                    space update_required corr_keytab[]",
    "                                    dba_sellist[] dpl_sellist[]",
    "                                    dummy_tab extract[] total[]",
    "                                    x_header[] x_namtab[] dummytc",
    "                                    sy-tabix results import_results[]",
    "                                    import_spec_mode",
    "                                    complex_selconds_used.",
    "      ENDIF.",
    "      called_by_cluster = calmode_safe. calling_cluster = calcls_safe.",
    "      REFRESH extract.",
    "    ENDIF.",
    "  ELSEIF action EQ 'SAVE'.",
    "    PERFORM x_call_viewmaintenance IN PROGRAM (fpool_name)",
    "                        USING i_uselcltbl",
    "                                import_mode corr_number 'SAVE' 'U'",
    "                                view_name tot_name ext_name space space",
    "                                update_required corr_keytab[]",
    "                                dba_sellist[] dpl_sellist[] dummy_tab",
    "                                extract[] total[] x_header[] x_namtab[]",
    "                                dummytc sy-tabix results",
    "                                import_results[] import_spec_mode",
    "                                complex_selconds_used.",
    "  ENDIF.",
    "  LOOP AT ix_to_modify WHERE action EQ 'TIN' OR action EQ 'TEX'.",
    "    READ TABLE total INTO extract INDEX ix_to_modify-tot_index.",
    "    CASE ix_to_modify-action.",
    "      WHEN 'TIN'.",
    "        <x_action> = task_add.",
    "      WHEN 'TEX'.",
    "        <x_action> = task_del.",
    "    ENDCASE.",
    "    APPEND extract.",
    "  ENDLOOP.",
    "  IF sy-subrc EQ 0.",
    "    CALL FUNCTION 'VIEW_MAINTENANCE_LOW_LEVEL'",
    "         EXPORTING",
    "              corr_number           = corr_number",
    "              fcode                 = 'EXED'",
    "              view_action           = 'T'",
    "              view_name             = view_name",
    "              complex_selconds_used = complex_selconds_used",
    "         IMPORTING",
    "              update_required       = update_required",
    "         TABLES",
    "              corr_keytab           = corr_keytab",
    "              dba_sellist           = dba_sellist",
    "              dpl_sellist           = dpl_sellist",
    "              excl_cua_funct        = dummy_tab",
    "              extract               = extract",
    "              total                 = total",
    "              x_header              = x_header",
    "              x_namtab              = x_namtab",
    "         EXCEPTIONS",
    "              missing_corr_number   = 1.",
    "    fb_rc = sy-subrc.",
    "    called_by_cluster = calmode_safe. calling_cluster = calcls_safe.",
    "  ENDIF.",
    "  IMPORT extract FROM MEMORY ID mem_id.",
    "  IF fb_rc EQ 0.",
    "    LOOP AT extract.",
    "      READ TABLE total INTO extract WITH KEY <x_key> BINARY SEARCH. \"#EC WARNOK",
    "      IF <x_action> CO delete_flags AND h_status-st_delete NE geloescht.",
    "        DELETE extract.",
    "      ELSE.",
    "        MODIFY extract.",
    "      ENDIF.",
    "    ENDLOOP.",
    "    PERFORM vim_get_global_field_value IN PROGRAM (fpool_name)",
    "                                      USING 'VIM_RESULTS_OF_EXT_MOD'",

    "                                            h_lg.",

    "    results-rc_tin = vmnd_results-rc_tin.",
    "    results-rc_tex = vmnd_results-rc_tex.",
    "  ENDIF.",
    "  IF restore_local_memory NE space.",
    "    PERFORM vim_restore_local_memory IN PROGRAM (fpool_name).",
    "    PERFORM vim_set_global_field_value IN PROGRAM (fpool_name)",
    "                                       USING 'COUNTER' 'I'",

    "    PERFORM vim_set_global_field_value IN PROGRAM (fpool_name)",
    "                                       USING 'FIRSTLINE' 'I'",
    "                                             firstline_safe h_lg.",
    "    PERFORM vim_set_global_field_value IN PROGRAM (fpool_name)",
    "                                       USING 'NEXTLINE' 'I'",
    "                                             nextline_safe h_lg.",
    "    PERFORM vim_set_global_field_value IN PROGRAM (fpool_name)",
    "                                       USING 'LOOPLINES' 'I'",

    "    PERFORM vim_set_global_field_value IN PROGRAM (fpool_name)",
    "                                       USING 'VIM_ACT_DYNP_VIEW' 'C'",
    "                                             name_for_restore h_lg.",
    "    PERFORM vim_set_global_field_value IN PROGRAM (fpool_name)",
    "                                       USING 'EXIND' 'I'",
    "                                             index_safe h_lg.",
    "  ENDIF.",
    "  IF fb_rc NE 0. RAISE missing_corr_number. ENDIF.",
    "ENDFUNCTION.                    \"#EC CI_VALPAR"

schema.description: Read one active function module interface and source through the SAP repository helper. Read-only and allowed for customer or standard function modules. Preserves raw updateTaskMode; updateTask is true for any noninitial update mode, including numeric SAP modes, not only X. Mode validity/meaning is not inferred. Returns a deterministic SHA-256 fingerprint; includeExecutionSupport additionally resolves scalar, flat-structure, and table parameter shapes through DDIC.

  "source": [
    "FUNCTION view_maintenance_low_level.",
    "*\"----------------------------------------------------------------------",
    "*\"*\"Lokale Schnittstelle:",
    "*\"  IMPORTING",
    "*\"     VALUE(CORR_NUMBER) LIKE  E070-TRKORR DEFAULT ' '",
    "*\"     VALUE(FCODE) DEFAULT 'RDED'",
    "*\"     VALUE(VIEW_ACTION) DEFAULT 'S'",
    "*\"     VALUE(VIEW_NAME) LIKE  DD02V-TABNAME",
    "*\"     VALUE(RFC_DESTINATION_FOR_UPGRADE) LIKE  RFCDES-RFCDEST DEFAULT",
    "*\"       ' '",
    "*\"     VALUE(CLIENT_FOR_UPGRADE) LIKE  SY-MANDT DEFAULT ' '",
    "*\"     VALUE(COMPLEX_SELCONDS_USED) LIKE  TVDIR-FLAG DEFAULT ' '",
    "*\"     VALUE(NO_WARNING_FOR_CLIENTINDEP) DEFAULT ' '",
    "*\"     REFERENCE(OC_INST) TYPE REF TO  CL_VIEWFIELDS_ORG_CRIT OPTIONAL",
    "*\"  EXPORTING",
    "*\"     VALUE(LAST_ACT_ENTRY) LIKE  SY-TABIX",
    "*\"     VALUE(UCOMM)",
    "*\"     VALUE(UPDATE_REQUIRED)",
    "*\"     VALUE(CORR_NUMBER) LIKE  E070-TRKORR",
    "*\"     VALUE(ACTION_OUT) TYPE  SYCHAR01",
    "*\"  TABLES",
    "*\"      CORR_KEYTAB STRUCTURE  E071K",
    "*\"      DBA_SELLIST STRUCTURE  VIMSELLIST",
    "*\"      DPL_SELLIST STRUCTURE  VIMSELLIST",
    "*\"      EXCL_CUA_FUNCT STRUCTURE  VIMEXCLFUN",
    "*\"      EXTRACT",
    "*\"      TOTAL",
    "*\"      X_HEADER STRUCTURE  VIMDESC",
    "*\"      X_NAMTAB STRUCTURE  VIMNAMTAB",
    "*\"  EXCEPTIONS",
    "*\"      FUNCTION_NOT_FOUND",
    "*\"      MISSING_CORR_NUMBER",
    "*\"      NO_VALUE_FOR_SUBSET_IDENT",
    "*\"      SAVING_CORRECTION_FAILED",
    "*\"----------------------------------------------------------------------",
    "",
    "*----------------------------------------------------------------------*",
    "* data declarations                                                    *",
    "*----------------------------------------------------------------------*",
    "  DATA: function_name(35) TYPE c,",
    "        view_fct_pref(35) TYPE c VALUE 'VIEWPROC_',         \"09 Zeichen",
    "        tabl_fct_pref(35) TYPE c VALUE 'TABLEPROC_',        \"10 Zeichen",
    "*     FPOOL LIKE TRDIR-NAME VALUE 'SAPL    ', RC LIKE SY-SUBRC,",
    "        fpool LIKE trdir-name, rc LIKE sy-subrc,",
    "        length LIKE sy-fdpos, calmode_safe(1) TYPE c,",
    "        specmode_safe(1) TYPE c, specfunctions(4) TYPE c,",
    "        calcls_safe TYPE vcl_name,",
    "      read_texttab(1) TYPE c.                                \"SW Textimp",
    "  FIELD-SYMBOLS: <function_name>.",
    "",
    "*----------------------------------------------------------------------*",
    "* build function name form view/table name and related prefix          *",
    "*----------------------------------------------------------------------*",
    "  READ TABLE x_header INDEX 1.",
    "  IF x_header-bastab EQ space.",
    "    MOVE: view_fct_pref TO function_name,",
    "          x_header-maintview TO function_name+9.         \".. Subviews",
    "  ELSE.",
    "    MOVE: tabl_fct_pref TO function_name,",
    "          x_header-area TO function_name+10.",
    "  ENDIF.",
    "  IF function_name CA forbidden_func_name_chars.",
    "    PERFORM replace_forbidden_chars USING forbidden_func_name_chars",
    "                                          function_name.",
    "  ENDIF.",
    "*----------------------------------------------------------------------*",
    "* check if function to call exists in library                          *",
    "*----------------------------------------------------------------------*",
    "  length = STRLEN( function_name ).",
    "  ASSIGN function_name(length) TO <function_name>.",
    "  READ TABLE alr_checked_views WITH KEY = x_header-viewname",
    "                               BINARY SEARCH",
    "                               TRANSPORTING NO FIELDS.",
    "  IF sy-subrc NE 0.",
    "    SELECT SINGLE * FROM tfdir WHERE funcname EQ <function_name>.",
    "    IF sy-subrc NE 0.",
    "      RAISE function_not_found.",
    "    ENDIF.",
    "    INSERT x_header-viewname INTO alr_checked_views INDEX sy-tabix.",
    "  ENDIF.",
    "*----------------------------------------------------------------------*",
    "* initialize RFC-destination for current view/table                    *",
    "*----------------------------------------------------------------------*",
    "  fpool   = x_header-fpoolname.",
    "  vim_default_rfc_dest-viewname = x_header-viewname.",
    "  vim_default_rfc_dest-rfcdest  = rfc_destination_for_upgrade.",
    "  PERFORM vim_set_global_field_value IN PROGRAM (fpool)",
    "            USING 'VIM_DEFAULT_RFC_DEST' 'C' vim_default_rfc_dest rc.",
    "*----------------------------------------------------------------------*",
    "* initialize client for upgrade for current view/table                 *",
    "*----------------------------------------------------------------------*",
    "  vim_default_upgr_clnt-viewname = x_header-viewname.",
    "  vim_default_upgr_clnt-client  = client_for_upgrade.",
    "  PERFORM vim_set_global_field_value IN PROGRAM (fpool)",
    "            USING 'VIM_DEFAULT_UPGR_CLNT' 'C' vim_default_upgr_clnt rc.",
    "*----------------------------------------------------------------------*",
    "* set flag if called by viewcluster maintenance                        *",
    "*----------------------------------------------------------------------*",
    "  PERFORM vim_get_global_field_value IN PROGRAM (fpool)",
    "            USING 'VIM_CALLED_BY_CLUSTER' 'C' calmode_safe rc.",
    "  PERFORM vim_get_global_field_value IN PROGRAM (fpool)",
    "            USING 'VIM_CALLING_CLUSTER' 'C' calcls_safe rc.",
    "  IF called_by_cluster NE calmode_safe.",
    "    PERFORM vim_set_global_field_value IN PROGRAM (fpool)",
    "              USING 'VIM_CALLED_BY_CLUSTER' 'C' called_by_cluster rc.",
    "  ENDIF.",
    "  IF calling_cluster NE calcls_safe.",
    "    PERFORM vim_set_global_field_value IN PROGRAM (fpool)",
    "              USING 'VIM_CALLING_CLUSTER' 'C' calling_cluster rc.",
    "  ENDIF.",
    "*----------------------------------------------------------------------*",
    "* set variables if special functions requested                         *",
    "*----------------------------------------------------------------------*",
    "  IF fcode = vim_read_text.                               \"SW Textimp ..",
    "    fcode = read.",
    "    IF x_header-texttbexst <> space.",
    "      read_texttab = 'X'.",
    "    ENDIF.",
    "  ENDIF.                                                  \".. SW Textimp",
    "  IF fcode EQ 'EXED' OR fcode EQ 'COMP'.",
    "    PERFORM vim_get_global_field_value IN PROGRAM (fpool)",
    "              USING 'VIM_SPECIAL_MODE' 'C' specmode_safe rc.",
    "    CASE fcode.",
    "      WHEN 'EXED'.",
    "        PERFORM vim_set_global_field_value IN PROGRAM (fpool)",
    "                  USING 'VIM_SPECIAL_MODE' 'C' vim_extedit rc.",
    "      WHEN 'COMP'.",
    "        PERFORM vim_set_global_field_value IN PROGRAM (fpool)",
    "                  USING 'VIM_SPECIAL_MODE' 'C' vim_direct_upgrade rc.",
    "    ENDCASE.",
    "    specfunctions = fcode. fcode = edit.",
    "  ENDIF.",
    "*----------------------------------------------------------------------*",
    "* set flag if complex selection conditions in sellist                  *",
    "*----------------------------------------------------------------------*",
    "  IF complex_selconds_used NE space.",
    "    READ TABLE dba_sellist INDEX 1.",
    "    IF sy-subrc EQ 0 AND dba_sellist-cond_kind EQ space.",
    "      dba_sellist-cond_kind = 'C'. MODIFY dba_sellist INDEX 1.",
    "    ENDIF.",
    "    READ TABLE dpl_sellist INDEX 1.",
    "    IF sy-subrc EQ 0 AND dpl_sellist-cond_kind EQ space.",
    "      dpl_sellist-cond_kind = 'C'. MODIFY dpl_sellist INDEX 1.",
    "    ENDIF.",
    "  ENDIF.",
    "*----------------------------------------------------------------------*",
    "* forward NO_WARNING... flag                                           *",
    "*----------------------------------------------------------------------*",
    "  PERFORM vim_set_global_field_value IN PROGRAM (fpool)",
    "     USING 'VIM_NO_WARNING_FOR_CLIINDEP' 'C' no_warning_for_clientindep",
    "           rc.",
    "  PERFORM vim_set_oc IN PROGRAM (fpool) USING oc_inst.",
    "*----------------------------------------------------------------------*",
    "* call requested function                                              *",
    "*----------------------------------------------------------------------*",
    "  CALL FUNCTION <function_name>",
    "    EXPORTING",
    "      fcode                     = fcode",
    "      view_action               = view_action",
    "      view_name                 = view_name",
    "      corr_number               = corr_number",
    "    IMPORTING",
    "      last_act_entry            = last_act_entry",
    "      ucomm                     = ucomm",
    "      update_required           = update_required",
    "    TABLES",
    "      corr_keytab               = corr_keytab",
    "      dba_sellist               = dba_sellist",
    "      dpl_sellist               = dpl_sellist",
    "      excl_cua_funct            = excl_cua_funct",
    "      extract                   = extract",
    "      total                     = total",
    "      x_header                  = x_header",
    "      x_namtab                  = x_namtab",
    "    EXCEPTIONS",
    "      missing_corr_number       = 01",
    "      no_value_for_subset_ident = 02",
    "      saving_correction_failed  = 03.",
    "  CASE sy-subrc.",
    "    WHEN 1.",
    "      RAISE missing_corr_number.",
    "    WHEN 2.",
    "      RAISE no_value_for_subset_ident.",
    "    WHEN 3.",
    "      IF vim_import_profile NE space.\"HCG delete for next BC-Set object",
    "        CLEAR: called_by_cluster, calling_cluster.",
    "      ENDIF.",
    "      RAISE saving_correction_failed.",
    "  ENDCASE.",
    "",
    "  IF read_texttab = 'X'.                                  \"SW Textimp ..",
    "    CALL FUNCTION <function_name>",
    "      EXPORTING",
    "        fcode                     = vim_read_text",
    "        view_action               = view_action",
    "        view_name                 = view_name",
    "        corr_number               = corr_number",
    "      IMPORTING",
    "        last_act_entry            = last_act_entry",
    "        ucomm                     = ucomm",
    "        update_required           = update_required",
    "      TABLES",
    "        corr_keytab               = corr_keytab",
    "        dba_sellist               = dba_sellist",
    "        dpl_sellist               = dpl_sellist",
    "        excl_cua_funct            = excl_cua_funct",
    "        extract                   = extract",
    "        total                     = total",
    "        x_header                  = x_header",
    "        x_namtab                  = x_namtab",
    "      EXCEPTIONS",
    "        missing_corr_number       = 01",
    "        no_value_for_subset_ident = 02",
    "        saving_correction_failed  = 03.",
    "    CASE sy-subrc.",
    "      WHEN 1.",
    "        RAISE missing_corr_number.",
    "      WHEN 2.",
    "        RAISE no_value_for_subset_ident.",
    "      WHEN 3.",
    "        RAISE saving_correction_failed.",
    "    ENDCASE.",
    "  ENDIF.                                                  \".. SW Textimp",
    "*----------------------------------------------------------------------*",
    "* get new export parameters                                            *",
    "*----------------------------------------------------------------------*",
    "  PERFORM vim_get_global_field_value IN PROGRAM (fpool)",
    "            USING '<STATUS>-CORR_NBR' 'C' corr_number rc.",
    "  PERFORM vim_get_global_field_value IN PROGRAM (fpool)",
    "            USING 'MAINT_MODE' 'C' action_out rc.",
    "*----------------------------------------------------------------------*",
    "* reset flag if called by viewcluster maintenance                      *",
    "*----------------------------------------------------------------------*",
    "  IF called_by_cluster NE calmode_safe.",
    "    PERFORM vim_set_global_field_value IN PROGRAM (fpool)",
    "              USING 'VIM_CALLED_BY_CLUSTER' 'C' calmode_safe rc.",
    "  ENDIF.",
    "  IF calling_cluster NE calcls_safe.",
    "    PERFORM vim_set_global_field_value IN PROGRAM (fpool)",
    "              USING 'VIM_CALLING_CLUSTER' 'C' calcls_safe rc.",
    "  ENDIF.",
    "  CLEAR: called_by_cluster, calling_cluster.",
    "*----------------------------------------------------------------------*",
    "* reset variables if special functions requested                       *",
    "*----------------------------------------------------------------------*",
    "  CASE specfunctions.",
    "    WHEN 'EXED'.",
    "      PERFORM vim_set_global_field_value IN PROGRAM (fpool)",
    "                USING 'VIM_SPECIAL_MODE' 'C' specmode_safe rc.",
    "  ENDCASE.",
    "ENDFUNCTION."

schema.description: Read one active function module interface and source through the SAP repository helper. Read-only and allowed for customer or standard function modules. Preserves raw updateTaskMode; updateTask is true for any noninitial update mode, including numeric SAP modes, not only X. Mode validity/meaning is not inferred. Returns a deterministic SHA-256 fingerprint; includeExecutionSupport additionally resolves scalar, flat-structure, and table parameter shapes through DDIC.

    "FUNCTION view_maintenance_given_data.",
    "*\"----------------------------------------------------------------------",
    "*\"*\"Lokale Schnittstelle:",
    "*\"  IMPORTING",
    "*\"     VALUE(ACTION)",
    "*\"     VALUE(CORR_NUMBER) LIKE  E070-TRKORR DEFAULT '          '",
    "*\"     VALUE(GENERATE_MAINT_TOOL_IF_MISSING) DEFAULT ' '",
    "*\"     VALUE(VIEW_NAME) LIKE  DD02V-TABNAME",
    "*\"     VALUE(NO_WARNING_FOR_CLIENTINDEP) DEFAULT ' '",
    "*\"     VALUE(RFC_DESTINATION_FOR_UPGRADE) LIKE  RFCDES-RFCDEST DEFAULT",
    "*\"       ' '",
    "*\"     VALUE(CLIENT_FOR_UPGRADE) LIKE  SY-MANDT DEFAULT ' '",
    "*\"     VALUE(VARIANT_FOR_SELECTION) LIKE  TVIMV-VARIANT DEFAULT ' '",
    "*\"     VALUE(COMPLEX_SELCONDS_USED) LIKE  TVDIR-FLAG DEFAULT ' '",
    "*\"  TABLES",
    "*\"      DATA",
    "*\"      DBA_SELLIST STRUCTURE  VIMSELLIST OPTIONAL",
    "*\"      EXCL_CUA_FUNCT STRUCTURE  VIMEXCLFUN OPTIONAL",
    "*\"  EXCEPTIONS",
    "*\"      CLIENT_REFERENCE",
    "*\"      FOREIGN_LOCK",
    "*\"      INVALID_ACTION",
    "*\"      NO_CLIENTINDEPENDENT_AUTH",
    "*\"      NO_DATABASE_FUNCTION",
    "*\"      NO_SHOW_AUTH",
    "*\"      NO_TVDIR_ENTRY",
    "*\"      NO_UPD_AUTH",
    "*\"      ONLY_SHOW_ALLOWED",
    "*\"      SYSTEM_FAILURE",
    "*\"      UNKNOWN_FIELD_IN_DBA_SELLIST",
    "*\"      VIEW_NOT_FOUND",
    "*\"----------------------------------------------------------------------",
    "",
    "*----------------------------------------------------------------------*",
    "* Datenvereinbarungen                                                  *",
    "*----------------------------------------------------------------------*",
    "  DATA: act_level LIKE authb-actvt,    \"Aktion zur Berecht.-prüfg.",
    "        only_show_allowed TYPE c,      \"flag: only show allowed",
    "        countx TYPE i,                 \"Zähler für Ankreuzfelder",
    "        u(1) TYPE c VALUE 'U',         \"Ändern",
    "        s(1) TYPE c VALUE 'S',         \"Anzeigen, Subset",
    "        t(1) TYPE c VALUE 'T',         \"Transport",
    "        x(1) TYPE c VALUE 'X',         \"gesetztes Flag",
    "        r(1) TYPE c VALUE 'R',         \"read-only",
    "        all_substflds_initial(1) TYPE c,                                 \"#EC NEEDED",
    "        \"Flag: alle Subset-Felder leer",
    "        dd_selcond_lines LIKE sy-tfill,\"Anzahl Selektionsbed. aus DD",
    "      usr_selcond_lines LIKE sy-tfill, \"Anzahl übergebene Selektionsbed.",
    "        table_type(11) TYPE c,         \"type of table to use",
    "        table_length TYPE i,           \"length of current table",
    "        enqueue_processed(1) TYPE c.",
    "* DATA: BEGIN OF MODULPOOL,",
    "*         PREFIX(4) VALUE 'SAPL',",
    "*         AREA LIKE TVDIR-AREA,",
    "*       END OF MODULPOOL.",
    "  DATA: modulpool LIKE trdir-name.",
    "  DATA: BEGIN OF header OCCURS 1.",
    "          INCLUDE STRUCTURE vimdesc.",
    "  DATA: END OF header.",
    "",
    "  DATA: BEGIN OF namtab OCCURS 50.",
    "          INCLUDE STRUCTURE vimnamtab.",
    "  DATA: END OF namtab.",
    "",
    "  DATA: BEGIN OF rangetab OCCURS 50.",
    "          INCLUDE STRUCTURE vimsellist.",
    "  DATA: END OF rangetab.",
    "",
    "  FIELD-SYMBOLS: <data_x> TYPE x.",
    "",
    "  TRANSLATE: action TO UPPER CASE,                        \"#EC SYNTCHAR",
    "             view_name TO UPPER CASE.                     \"#EC SYNTCHAR",
    "*----------------------------------------------------------------------*",
    "* Prüfen, ob gültige Eingabe erfolgte und ACT_LEVEL setzen",
    "*----------------------------------------------------------------------*",
    "  CASE action.",
    "    WHEN u. MOVE '02' TO act_level.",
    "    WHEN t. MOVE '02' TO act_level. \"auth_check for corr_maint like upd",
    "    WHEN s. MOVE '03' TO act_level.",
    "    WHEN OTHERS. MESSAGE e001 RAISING invalid_action.",
    "  ENDCASE.",
    "*---------------------------------------------------------------------*",
    "* ggf. temporäre Pflegeobjekte erzeugen.                              *",
    "*---------------------------------------------------------------------*",
    "* IF GENERATE_MAINT_TOOL_IF_MISSING NE SPACE.",
    "*   PERFORM GENERATE_TEMPORAL_OBJECTS USING VIEW_NAME.",
    "* ENDIF.",
    "",
    "*----------------------------------------------------------------------*",
    "* Funktionsbaustein zum Füllen der Kontrollblocktabellen rufen         *",
    "*----------------------------------------------------------------------*",
    "  REFRESH namtab.",
    "  CLEAR   namtab.",
    "  REFRESH header.",
    "  CLEAR   header.",
    "  REFRESH rangetab.",
    "  CLEAR   rangetab.",
    "  CALL FUNCTION 'VIEW_GET_DDIC_INFO'",
    "       EXPORTING",
    "            viewname              = view_name",
    "            variant_for_selection = variant_for_selection",
    "       TABLES",
    "            x_header              = header",
    "            x_namtab              = namtab",
    "            sellist               = rangetab",
    "       EXCEPTIONS",
    "            no_tvdir_entry        = 3",
    "            table_not_found       = 5.",
    "*----------------------------------------------------------------------*",
    "* ggf. Ausnahmen behandeln                                             *",
    "*----------------------------------------------------------------------*",
    "  CASE sy-subrc.",
    "    WHEN 3.",
    "      MESSAGE e037 WITH view_name RAISING no_tvdir_entry.",
    "    WHEN 5.",
    "      MESSAGE e028 WITH view_name RAISING view_not_found.",
    "  ENDCASE.",
    "  READ TABLE header INDEX 1.",
    "*---------------------------------------------------------------------*",
    "* Berechtigungsprüfung                                                *",
    "*---------------------------------------------------------------------*",
    "  IF header-newgener EQ space. \"4.5a: support individual auth. checks",
    "    CLEAR only_show_allowed.",
    "    CALL FUNCTION 'VIEW_AUTHORITY_CHECK'",
    "         EXPORTING",
    "              view_action    = action",
    "              view_name      = view_name",
    "              no_warning_for_clientindep = no_warning_for_clientindep",
    "         EXCEPTIONS",
    "              table_not_found                 = 5",
    "              no_authority                    = 8",
    "              no_clientindependent_authority  = 9",
    "              no_linedependent_authority      = 10.",
    "    CASE sy-subrc.",
    "      WHEN 5.",
    "        MESSAGE e028 WITH view_name RAISING view_not_found.",
    "      WHEN 9.",
    "        MESSAGE ID 'TB' TYPE 'E' NUMBER 109       \"no cli-indep auth",
    "                RAISING no_clientindependent_auth.",
    "      WHEN 8 OR 10.",
    "        IF act_level EQ '02'.          \"no update authority",
    "          CALL FUNCTION 'VIEW_AUTHORITY_CHECK'  \"check show authority",
    "               EXPORTING",
    "                 view_action                = s",
    "                 view_name                  = view_name",
    "                 no_warning_for_clientindep = no_warning_for_clientindep",
    "               EXCEPTIONS",
    "                 no_authority               = 8",
    "                 no_linedependent_authority = 10.",
    "          CASE sy-subrc.",
    "            WHEN 0.                    \"only show allowed",
    "              MOVE: s TO action,",
    "*                    s TO i_action,     \"UF2136609/1998",
    "                    '03' TO act_level, x TO only_show_allowed.",
    "              MESSAGE i051 RAISING only_show_allowed.",
    "            WHEN 8.",
    "* no authority respecting to S_TABU_DIS",
    "              MESSAGE e052 RAISING no_show_auth.",
    "            WHEN 10.",
    "* no authority respecting to S_TABU_LIN",
    "              MESSAGE e756 RAISING no_show_auth",
    "               WITH sy-msgv1 sy-msgv2 sy-msgv3 sy-msgv4.",
    "* Sie haben keine zeilenbezogene Pflegeeberechtigung für diese Tabelle",
    "          ENDCASE.                     \"sy-subrc from  2nd auth_check",
    "        ELSE.                          \"act_level <> 02",
    "          IF sy-subrc = 8.",
    "* no authority respecting to S_TABU_DIS",
    "            MESSAGE e053 RAISING no_show_auth.",
    "          ELSE.                        \"sy-subrc = 10",
    "* no authority respecting to S_TABU_LIN",
    "            MESSAGE e755 RAISING no_show_auth",
    "             WITH sy-msgv1 sy-msgv2 sy-msgv3 sy-msgv4.",
    "*   Sie haben keine zeilenbezogene Anzeigeberechtigung für diese Tabelle",
    "          ENDIF.",
    "        ENDIF.",
    "    ENDCASE.",
    "  ENDIF.",
    "*----------------------------------------------------------------------*",
    "*  Rangetab aus DDIC mit DBA_SELLIST aus Schnittstelle mischen",
    "*----------------------------------------------------------------------*",
    "  DESCRIBE TABLE rangetab LINES dd_selcond_lines.",
    "  DESCRIBE TABLE dba_sellist LINES usr_selcond_lines.",
    "  IF dd_selcond_lines EQ 0 AND usr_selcond_lines NE 0.",
    "    MOVE x TO header-selection.",
    "    MODIFY header INDEX 1.",
    "  ELSEIF dd_selcond_lines NE 0 AND usr_selcond_lines NE 0.",
    "    IF header-subsetflag EQ x.",
    "      LOOP AT rangetab WHERE ddic EQ s.",
    "        LOOP AT dba_sellist WHERE viewfield EQ rangetab-viewfield",
    "                              AND ( ( negation EQ space AND",
    "                                      operator EQ 'EQ' ) OR",
    "                                    ( negation NE space AND",
    "                                      operator EQ 'NE' ) ).",
    "          MOVE: dba_sellist-value TO rangetab-value,",
    "                s TO dba_sellist-ddic.",
    "          MODIFY dba_sellist.",
    "          SUBTRACT 1 FROM usr_selcond_lines.",
    "        ENDLOOP.",
    "        IF sy-subrc EQ 0.",
    "          MODIFY rangetab.",
    "        ENDIF.",
    "      ENDLOOP.",
    "    ENDIF.",
    "    IF usr_selcond_lines NE 0.",
    "      READ TABLE rangetab INDEX dd_selcond_lines.",
    "      MOVE 'AND' TO rangetab-and_or.",
    "      MODIFY rangetab INDEX dd_selcond_lines.",
    "    ENDIF.",
    "  ENDIF.",
    "  IF usr_selcond_lines NE 0.",
    "    LOOP AT dba_sellist WHERE ddic EQ space.",
    "      READ TABLE namtab WITH KEY dba_sellist-viewfield. \"#EC WARNOK",
    "      IF sy-subrc EQ 0.",
    "        dba_sellist-tabix = sy-tabix.",
    "      ELSE.",
    "        RAISE unknown_field_in_dba_sellist.",
    "      ENDIF.",
    "      rangetab = dba_sellist.",
    "      APPEND rangetab.",
    "    ENDLOOP.",
    "  ENDIF.",
    "*----------------------------------------------------------------------*",
    "* Datenbereichsgrenzen setzen                                          *",
    "*----------------------------------------------------------------------*",
    "* IF HEADER-SUBSETFLAG EQ X.",
    "*----------------------------------------------------------------------*",
    "* prüfen, ob für alle Subsetfelder Werte fehlen                        *",
    "*----------------------------------------------------------------------*",
    "*   PERFORM CHECK_ALL_SUBSTFIELDS TABLES NAMTAB RANGETAB",
    "*                                 CHANGING ALL_SUBSTFLDS_INITIAL.",
    "* ENDIF.",
    "*-IF ALL_SUBSTFLDS_INITIAL EQ X OR SHOW_SELECTION_POPUP EQ X.",
    "* ---------------------------------------------------------------------*",
    "*-Funktionsbaustein zur Eingabe der Datenbereichsgrenzen rufen         *",
    "* ---------------------------------------------------------------------*",
    "*-  DO.",
    "*     CALL FUNCTION 'TABLE_RANGE_INPUT'",
    "*-      EXPORTING",
    "*-        TABLE             = VIEW_NAME",
    "*       TABLES",
    "*-        X_HEADER          = HEADER",
    "*         X_NAMTAB          = NAMTAB",
    "*-        SELLIST           = RANGETAB",
    "*-      EXCEPTIONS",
    "*         NO_INPUT          = 2",
    "*-        CANCELLED_BY_USER = 12.",
    "*     IF SY-SUBRC EQ 0 OR HEADER-SUBSETFLAG NE X.",
    "*-      EXIT.",
    "*-    ENDIF.",
    "*     CASE SY-SUBRC.",
    "*-      WHEN 2.",
    "*         IF HEADER-SUBSETFLAG NE SPACE.",
    "*-          PERFORM CHECK_ALL_SUBSTFIELDS TABLES NAMTAB RANGETAB",
    "*-                                CHANGING ALL_SUBSTFLDS_INITIAL.",
    "*           IF ALL_SUBSTFLDS_INITIAL EQ SPACE. EXIT. ENDIF.",
    "*         ELSE.",
    "*           EXIT.",
    "*         ENDIF.",
    "*       WHEN 12.",
    "*         CALL FUNCTION 'POPUP_TO_CONFIRM_STEP'",
    "*           EXPORTING",
    "*             TITEL     = TEXT-024",
    "*             TEXTLINE1 = TEXT-025",
    "*             TEXTLINE2 = TEXT-026",
    "*           IMPORTING",
    "*             ANSWER    = ANSWER.",
    "*         IF ANSWER EQ 'J'.",
    "*           MOVE 12 TO SY-SUBRC.",
    "*           EXIT.",
    "*         ENDIF.",
    "*     ENDCASE.",
    "*     MESSAGE S038.",
    "*   ENDDO.",
    "*   IF SY-SUBRC NE 12 AND HEADER-SELECTION NE X.",
    "  IF header-selection NE x.",
    "    DESCRIBE TABLE rangetab LINES countx.",
    "    IF countx GT 0.",
    "      MOVE x TO header-selection.",
    "      MODIFY header INDEX 1.",
    "    ENDIF.",
    "  ENDIF.",
    "* ENDIF.",
    "* IF SY-SUBRC NE 12.",
    "*----------------------------------------------------------------------*",
    "* View sperren                                                         *",
    "*----------------------------------------------------------------------*",
    "  IF ( action EQ u OR action EQ t ) AND header-existency NE r.",
    "    CALL FUNCTION 'VIEW_ENQUEUE'",
    "         EXPORTING",
    "              view_name        = view_name",
    "              action           = 'E'",
    "              enqueue_mode     = 'E'",
    "              enqueue_range    = header-subsetflag",
    "         TABLES",
    "              sellist          = rangetab",
    "         EXCEPTIONS",
    "              foreign_lock     = 1",
    "              system_failure   = 2",
    "              table_not_found  = 5",
    "              client_reference = 7.",
    "*----------------------------------------------------------------------*",
    "* ggf. Ausnahmen behandeln                                             *",
    "*----------------------------------------------------------------------*",
    "    CASE sy-subrc.",
    "      WHEN 1.",
    "        MESSAGE i049 WITH sy-msgv1 RAISING foreign_lock.",
    "        MOVE: s TO action.",
    "      WHEN 2.",
    "        MESSAGE e050 WITH view_name RAISING system_failure.",
    "      WHEN 5.",
    "        MESSAGE e028 WITH view_name RAISING view_not_found.",
    "      WHEN 7.",
    "        MESSAGE e054 WITH sy-mandt RAISING client_reference.",
    "    ENDCASE.",
    "    enqueue_processed = 'X'.",
    "  ENDIF.",
    "*----------------------------------------------------------------------*",
    "* ggf. Funktionen ausschließen                                         *",
    "*----------------------------------------------------------------------*",
    "  IF only_show_allowed NE space.",
    "    MOVE 'AEND' TO excl_cua_funct-function. APPEND excl_cua_funct.",
    "  ENDIF.",
    "*----------------------------------------------------------------------*",
    "* Daten Pflegen                                                        *",
    "*----------------------------------------------------------------------*",
    "*   CALL FUNCTION 'VIEW_MAINTENANCE'",
    "*          EXPORTING",
    "*-            VIEW_NAME   = VIEW_NAME",
    "*             VIEW_ACTION = ACTION",
    "*-         TABLES",
    "*             X_HEADER       = HEADER",
    "*             X_NAMTAB       = NAMTAB",
    "*-            DBA_SELLIST    = RANGETAB",
    "*             EXCL_CUA_FUNCT = EXCL_CUA_FUNCT",
    "*-         EXCEPTIONS",
    "*             NO_DATABASE_FUNCTION      = 2",
    "*             NO_EDITOR_FUNCTION        = 3",
    "*             MISSING_CORR_NUMBER       = 4.",
    "*----------------------------------------------------------------------*",
    "* ggf. Ausnahmen behandeln                                             *",
    "*----------------------------------------------------------------------*",
    "*   CASE SY-SUBRC.",
    "*     WHEN 2.",
    "*       MESSAGE E022 RAISING NO_DATABASE_FUNCTION.",
    "*     WHEN 3.",
    "*       MESSAGE E023 RAISING NO_EDITOR_FUNCTION.",
    "*   ENDCASE.",
    "",
    "*-<<<-------------------------------------------------------------->>>>*",
    "* determine well-sized internal EXTRAC-table                           *",
    "*-<<<-------------------------------------------------------------->>>>*",
    "  ASSIGN data TO <data_x> CASTING.",
    "  DESCRIBE FIELD <data_x> LENGTH table_length IN BYTE MODE.",
    "  table_length = table_length div cl_abap_char_utilities=>charsize",
    "           + SIGN( table_length MOD cl_abap_char_utilities=>charsize ).",
    "  IF table_length LE ultra_short_tab.",
    "    MOVE 'ULTRA_SHORT'     TO table_type.",
    "    FREE: extract_vs, total_vs,",
    "          extract_s, total_s,",
    "          extract_m, total_m,",
    "          extract_l, total_l,",
    "          extract_vl, total_vl,",
    "          extract_ul, total_ul, total_us.",
    "  ELSEIF table_length LE very_short_tab.",
    "    MOVE 'VERY_SHORT'     TO table_type.",
    "    FREE: extract_us, total_us,",
    "          extract_s, total_s,",
    "          extract_m, total_m,",
    "          extract_l, total_l,",
    "          extract_vl, total_vl,",
    "          extract_ul, total_ul, total_vs.",
    "  ELSEIF table_length LE short_tab.",
    "    MOVE 'SHORT'     TO table_type.",
    "    FREE: extract_us, total_us,",
    "          extract_vs, total_vs,",
    "          extract_m, total_m,",
    "          extract_l, total_l,",
    "          extract_vl, total_vl,",
    "          extract_ul, total_ul, total_s.",
    "  ELSEIF table_length LE middle_tab.",
    "    MOVE 'MIDDLE'    TO table_type.",
    "    FREE: extract_us, total_us,",
    "          extract_vs, total_vs,",
    "          extract_s, total_s,",
    "          extract_l, total_l,",
    "          extract_vl, total_vl,",
    "          extract_ul, total_ul, total_m.",
    "  ELSEIF table_length LE long_tab.",
    "    MOVE 'LONG'    TO table_type.",
    "    FREE: extract_us, total_us,",
    "          extract_vs, total_vs,",
    "          extract_s, total_s,",
    "          extract_m, total_m,",
    "          extract_vl, total_vl,",
    "          extract_ul, total_ul, total_l.",
    "  ELSEIF table_length LE very_long_tab.",
    "    MOVE 'VERY_LONG'    TO table_type.",
    "    FREE: extract_us, total_us,",
    "          extract_vs, total_vs,",
    "          extract_s, total_s,",
    "          extract_m, total_m,",
    "          extract_l, total_l,",
    "          extract_ul, total_ul, total_vl.",
    "  ELSEIF table_length LE ultra_long_tab.",
    "    MOVE 'ULTRA_LONG'    TO table_type.",
    "    FREE: extract_us, total_us,",
    "          extract_vs, total_vs,",
    "          extract_s, total_s,",
    "          extract_m, total_m,",
    "          extract_l, total_l,",
    "          extract_vl, total_vl, total_ul.",
    "  ENDIF.",
    "  IF nbrd_texts_alr_read EQ space.",
    "    PERFORM set_numbered_texts.",
    "  ENDIF.",
    "  maint_mode = action.",
    "*-<<<-------------------------------------------------------------->>>>*",
    "* Entrypoint after changing maintenance mode (show <--> update)        *",
    "*-<<<-------------------------------------------------------------->>>>*",
    "  DO.",
    "*-<<<-------------------------------------------------------------->>>>*",
    "* Entrypoint after saving data into database                           *",
    "* Entrypoint after refreshing selected entries from database           *",
    "*-<<<-------------------------------------------------------------->>>>*",
    "    DO.",
    "*----------------------------------------------------------------------*",
    "* Edit data                                                            *",
    "*----------------------------------------------------------------------*",
    "      DO.",
    "        PERFORM call_maint_function TABLES data dba_sellist dba_sellist",
    "                                        header namtab excl_cua_funct",
    "                                    USING edit table_type maint_mode",
    "                                          rfc_destination_for_upgrade",
    "                                          corr_number client_for_upgrade",
    "                                          complex_selconds_used",
    "                                          update_flag.",
    "        CASE sy-subrc.",
    "          WHEN 1.",
    "            IF action EQ aendern.",
    "              MOVE action TO maint_mode.",
    "            ELSE.",
    "*             RAISE MISSING_CORR_NUMBER.",
    "            ENDIF.",
    "          WHEN 2.",
    "*           RAISE NO_VALUE_FOR_SUBSET_IDENT.",
    "          WHEN 8.",
    "            MESSAGE e022 RAISING no_database_function.",
    "          WHEN OTHERS.",
    "            EXIT.",
    "        ENDCASE.",
    "      ENDDO.",
    "*----------------------------------------------------------------------*",
    "*  Handle usercommands...                                              *",
    "*  ...at first handle commands which could cause loss of data          *",
    "*----------------------------------------------------------------------*",
    "      IF function EQ back. function = end. ENDIF.",
    "      IF ( function EQ switch_to_show_mode OR",
    "           function EQ get_another_view    OR",
    "           function EQ switch_transp_to_upd_mode OR",
    "           function EQ end ) AND",
    "         update_flag NE space.",
    "        PERFORM beenden.",
    "        CASE sy-subrc.",
    "          WHEN 0.",
    "            PERFORM call_maint_function TABLES data dba_sellist",
    "                                               dba_sellist header",
    "                                               namtab excl_cua_funct",
    "                                        USING save table_type maint_mode",
    "                                             rfc_destination_for_upgrade",
    "                                             corr_number",
    "                                             client_for_upgrade",
    "                                             complex_selconds_used",
    "                                             update_flag.",
    "            CASE sy-subrc.",
    "              WHEN 0. IF update_flag EQ space. EXIT. ENDIF.",
    "*             WHEN 1. RAISE MISSING_CORR_NUMBER.",
    "*             WHEN 2. RAISE NO_VALUE_FOR_SUBSET_IDENT.",
    "              WHEN 3.",
    "            ENDCASE.",
    "          WHEN 8. EXIT.",
    "          WHEN 12.",
    "        ENDCASE.",
    "*----------------------------------------------------------------------*",
    "*  ...2nd: transport request                                           *",
    "*----------------------------------------------------------------------*",
    "      ELSEIF function EQ transport.",
    "        IF update_flag NE space.",
    "          PERFORM transportieren.",
    "          CASE sy-subrc.",
    "            WHEN 0.",
    "              PERFORM call_maint_function TABLES data dba_sellist",
    "                                                 dba_sellist header",
    "                                                 namtab excl_cua_funct",
    "                                          USING save table_type",
    "                                                maint_mode",
    "                                             rfc_destination_for_upgrade",
    "                                          corr_number client_for_upgrade",
    "                                          complex_selconds_used",
    "                                          update_flag.",
    "              CASE sy-subrc.",
    "                WHEN 0. maint_mode = transportieren.",
    "*               WHEN 1. RAISE MISSING_CORR_NUMBER.",
    "*               WHEN 2. RAISE NO_VALUE_FOR_SUBSET_IDENT.",
    "                WHEN 3.",
    "              ENDCASE.",
    "            WHEN 8.",
    "              EXIT.",
    "            WHEN 12.",
    "          ENDCASE.",
    "        ELSE.",
    "          maint_mode = transportieren.",
    "        ENDIF.",
    "*----------------------------------------------------------------------*",
    "*  ...now reset or save requests                                       *",
    "*----------------------------------------------------------------------*",
    "      ELSEIF function EQ reset_list  OR",
    "             function EQ reset_entry OR",
    "             function EQ save.",
    "*----------------------------------------------------------------------*",
    "*  Refresh selected entries from database or save data into database   *",
    "*----------------------------------------------------------------------*",
    "        PERFORM call_maint_function TABLES data dba_sellist",
    "                                           dba_sellist header",
    "                                           namtab excl_cua_funct",

    "                                          rfc_destination_for_upgrade",

    "          WHEN 3.",
    "        ENDCASE.",
    "      ELSE.",
    "        EXIT.",
    "      ENDIF.",
    "    ENDDO.",
    "*----------------------------------------------------------------------*",
    "*  ...now other commands...                                            *",
    "*----------------------------------------------------------------------*",
    "    CASE function.",
    "      WHEN switch_to_show_mode.",
    "*     change maintenance mode from update to show",

    "        PERFORM x_enqueue TABLES dba_sellist",
    "                          USING view_name 'E' header-frm_af_enq",
    "                                header-subsetflag.    \"enqueue view",
    "        IF sy-subrc EQ 0.",

    "        ENDIF.",

    "*     change maintenance mode from transport to update",
    "        maint_mode = aendern.",
    "      WHEN transport.",
    "*     change maintenance mode from update to transport",
    "        maint_mode = transportieren.",
    "      WHEN OTHERS.",
    "*       IF HEADER-FRM_BF_END NE SPACE.",
    "*         PERFORM (HEADER-FRM_BF_END) IN PROGRAM (MODULPOOL).",
    "*       ENDIF.",
    "*       MOVE HEADER-AREA TO MODULPOOL-AREA.",
    "        modulpool = header-fpoolname.",
    "        PERFORM before_leaving_frame_function IN PROGRAM (modulpool)",
    "                USING header-frm_bf_end.",
    "        EXIT.",
    "    ENDCASE.",
    "  ENDDO.",
    "* ENDIF. \"sy-subrc 12.",
    "*----------------------------------------------------------------------*",

schema.description: Read one active function module interface and source through the SAP repository helper. Read-only and allowed for customer or standard function modules. Preserves raw updateTaskMode; updateTask is true for any noninitial update mode, including numeric SAP modes, not only X. Mode validity/meaning is not inferred. Returns a deterministic SHA-256 fingerprint; includeExecutionSupport additionally resolves scalar, flat-structure, and table parameter shapes through DDIC.

    "FUNCTION view_get_ddic_info.",
    "*\"----------------------------------------------------------------------",
    "*\"*\"Globale Schnittstelle:",
    "*\"  IMPORTING",
    "*\"     VALUE(VIEWNAME) LIKE  OCUS-TABLE",
