    "        ix LIKE sy-tabix, itvimv LIKE tvimv OCCURS 10 WITH HEADER LINE,",
    "        maint_x030l LIKE x030l,        \"Subviews ..",
    "        x031l_tab LIKE x031l OCCURS 10 WITH HEADER LINE,",
    "        viewfields_save LIKE dfies OCCURS 10 WITH HEADER LINE,",
    "*        dd27v_maint LIKE dd27v OCCURS 10 WITH HEADER LINE,",
    "*        dd27v_save LIKE dd27v OCCURS 10 WITH HEADER LINE,",
    "*        dd25v_maint type dd25v,",
    "        dd27p_maint TYPE TABLE OF dd27p WITH HEADER LINE",
    "         INITIAL SIZE 50,",
    "        save_tvdir_bastab(1) TYPE c,",
    "        hidden_field(1) TYPE c,        \"Feld ist auszublenden",
    "        orig_viewgrant(1) TYPE c,",
    "        state_tab_index LIKE sy-tabix, \".. Subviews",
    "        dummyvalue LIKE vimsellist-value, iflag(1) TYPE c,",
    "        x030l_dummy TYPE x030l,",
    "        max_trsp_keylen TYPE i,",
    "        dd02v_roottab TYPE dd02v,                     \"HCG 13.09.02",
    "        w_vc_dd25v TYPE dd25v.   \"view-cluster header-table.",
    "  \"XB int4434083 2001",
    "",
    "  DATA maxtr_tmp TYPE i.",
    "  DATA: BEGIN OF viewfields_key,",
    "          tabname LIKE dfies-tabname,",
    "          fieldname LIKE dfies-fieldname,",
    "          langu     LIKE sy-langu,",
    "        END OF viewfields_key.",
    "  DATA: BEGIN OF viewfields_key_s,",
    "          tabname LIKE dfies-tabname,",
    "          fieldname LIKE dfies-fieldname,",
    "        END OF viewfields_key_s.",
    "",
    "  FIELD-SYMBOLS: <hf>.",
    "",
    "  PERFORM set_constants_get_ddic_info.",
    "  CLEAR: x_header, x_namtab, sellist.",
    "  REFRESH: x_namtab, sellist.",
    "* Get header entry",
    "***********************************************************************",
    "  IF viewname NE last_tvdir_view or viewname is initial. \"20041228 UF",
    "    PERFORM read_tvdir USING viewname CHANGING maintview.",
    "    SELECT * FROM tvimf INTO TABLE tvimf_tab WHERE tabname EQ maintview.",
    "    \"Subviews",
    "    last_tvdir_view = viewname.",
    "  ENDIF.",
    "* Get nametab info",
    "***********************************************************************",
    "  IF viewname NE last_view.",
    "    save_tvdir_bastab = tvdir-bastab.  \"Subviews ..",
    "    IF tvdir-bastab = 'X' AND viewname <> maintview.",
    "*     Viewvariante auf Tabelle -> in PREPARE wie View zu behandeln!",
    "      CLEAR tvdir-bastab.",
    "    ENDIF.                             \".. Subviews",
    "    PERFORM prepare USING viewname.",
    "    last_view = viewname.",
    "    tvdir-bastab = save_tvdir_bastab.                       \"Subviews",
    "  ENDIF.",
    "  PERFORM get_fieldtab USING viewname",
    "                       CHANGING x030l",
    "                                viewfields[]",
    "                                textfields[].",
    "  IF maintview = viewname.             \"Subviews ..",
    "* view or table",
    "    maint_x030l = x030l.               \"gesetzt in PREPARE -> READ_DDIC",
    "  ELSE.",
    "* view variant",
    "    viewfields_save[] = viewfields[].",
    "    PERFORM get_main_fieldtab USING maintview",
    "                              CHANGING maint_x030l",
    "                                       viewfields[].",
    "    IF maint_x030l-tabtype = view_tab.",
    "* variant of a maintenance view",
    "      CALL FUNCTION 'DDIF_VIEW_GET'",
    "        EXPORTING",
    "          name      = maintview",
    "          langu     = sy-langu",
    "        IMPORTING",
    "          dd25v_wa  = w_dd25v",
    "        TABLES",
    "          dd27p_tab = dd27p_maint[].",
    "      mview_roottab = w_dd25v-roottab.",
    "    ELSE.",
    "* variant of a table",
    "*     Vorbedingung für GET_FIELD_TAB für MAINTVIEW:",
    "      READ TABLE state_tab WITH KEY maintview BINARY SEARCH.",
    "      IF sy-subrc <> 0.",
    "        state_tab_index = sy-tabix.",
    "        CLEAR state_tab.",
    "        state_tab-name = maintview.",
    "        state_tab-bastab = 'X'.",
    "        IF text_tab_exists = 'X'.      \"Subview beinhaltet Texttabelle",
    "          MOVE text_table_name TO state_tab-texttbname.",
    "          MOVE 'X' TO state_tab-texttbexst.",
    "        ENDIF.",
    "        INSERT state_tab INDEX state_tab_index.",
    "      ENDIF.",
    "      PERFORM get_fieldtab USING maintview  \"setzt glob. Var. VIEWFIELDS",
    "                           CHANGING x030l_dummy",
    "                                    viewfields[]",
    "                                    textfields[].",
    "    ENDIF.",
    "  ENDIF.                               \".. Subviews",
    "  MOVE master_fpool TO x_header-gui_prog.",
    "* Fill X_HEADER",
    "  max_trsp_keylen",
    "   = vim_max_trsp_keylength * cl_abap_char_utilities=>charsize.",
    "* 1. Get events",
    "***********************************************************************",
    "  LOOP AT tvimf_tab.",
    "    CASE tvimf_tab-event.",
    "      WHEN '01'. MOVE tvimf_tab-formname TO x_header-frm_bf_sav.",
    "      WHEN '02'. MOVE tvimf_tab-formname TO x_header-frm_af_sav.",
    "      WHEN '03'. MOVE tvimf_tab-formname TO x_header-frm_bf_del.",
    "      WHEN '04'. MOVE tvimf_tab-formname TO x_header-frm_af_del.",
    "      WHEN '05'. MOVE tvimf_tab-formname TO x_header-frm_on_new.",
    "      WHEN '06'. MOVE tvimf_tab-formname TO x_header-frm_af_org.",
    "      WHEN '07'. MOVE tvimf_tab-formname TO x_header-frm_bf_rpl.",
    "      WHEN '08'. MOVE tvimf_tab-formname TO x_header-frm_af_rpl.",
    "      WHEN '09'. MOVE tvimf_tab-formname TO x_header-frm_on_org.",
    "      WHEN '10'. MOVE tvimf_tab-formname TO x_header-frm_e071.",
    "      WHEN '11'. MOVE tvimf_tab-formname TO x_header-frm_e071ks.",
    "      WHEN '12'. MOVE tvimf_tab-formname TO x_header-frm_e071ka.",
    "      WHEN '13'. MOVE tvimf_tab-formname TO x_header-frm_bf_end.",
    "      WHEN '14'. MOVE tvimf_tab-formname TO x_header-frm_af_enq.",
    "      WHEN '15'. MOVE tvimf_tab-formname TO x_header-frm_bf_udl.",
    "      WHEN '16'. MOVE tvimf_tab-formname TO x_header-frm_af_udl.",
    "      WHEN '17'. MOVE tvimf_tab-formname TO x_header-frm_bf_prn.",
    "      WHEN '18'. MOVE tvimf_tab-formname TO x_header-frm_af_chk.",
    "      WHEN '19'. MOVE tvimf_tab-formname TO x_header-frm_af_ini.",
    "      WHEN '20'. MOVE tvimf_tab-formname TO x_header-frm_in_dss.",
    "      WHEN '21'. MOVE tvimf_tab-formname TO x_header-frm_h_flds.",
    "      WHEN '22'. MOVE tvimf_tab-formname TO x_header-frm_tltext.",
    "      WHEN '23'. MOVE tvimf_tab-formname TO x_header-frm_bf_adr.",
    "      WHEN '24'. MOVE tvimf_tab-formname TO x_header-frm_af_dlm.",
    "      WHEN '25'. MOVE tvimf_tab-formname TO x_header-frm_on_aut.",
    "      WHEN '26'. MOVE tvimf_tab-formname TO x_header-frm_bf_alv.\"UF",
    "      WHEN '27'. MOVE tvimf_tab-formname TO x_header-frm_af_uid.\"UF",
    "      WHEN 'AA'. MOVE tvimf_tab-formname TO x_header-frm_rp_get.",
    "      WHEN 'AB'. MOVE tvimf_tab-formname TO x_header-frm_rp_upd.",
    "      WHEN 'AC'. MOVE tvimf_tab-formname TO x_header-frm_rp_org.",
    "      WHEN 'AD'. MOVE tvimf_tab-formname TO x_header-frm_rp_cpl.",
    "      WHEN 'AE'. MOVE tvimf_tab-formname TO x_header-frm_rp_pos.",
    "      WHEN 'AF'. MOVE tvimf_tab-formname TO x_header-frm_tl_get.\"SW",
    "      WHEN 'AG'. MOVE tvimf_tab-formname TO x_header-frm_tl_org.\"SW",
    "      WHEN 'AH'. MOVE tvimf_tab-formname TO x_header-frm_tl_upd.\"SW",
    "      WHEN 'AI'. MOVE tvimf_tab-formname TO x_header-frm_bf_alv.\"UF",
    "      WHEN 'ST'. MOVE tvimf_tab-formname TO x_header-gui_prog.",
    "    ENDCASE.",
    "  ENDLOOP.",
    "* Fill X_HEADER",
    "***********************************************************************",
    "  MOVE-CORRESPONDING tvdir TO x_header.",
    "  PERFORM get_fpoolname USING    x_header-area              \"Fpoolname",
    "                        CHANGING x_header-fpoolname.",
    "  MOVE viewname TO x_header-viewname.  \"Subviews ..",
    "  MOVE maintview TO x_header-maintview.",
    "",
    "* maintenance flag from dd02l (dd02v) \"MF 2000-11-07",
    "  MOVE dd02v-mainflag TO x_header-mainflag.",
    "",
    "  CLEAR: x_header-generictrp, x_header-trgkeypos,",
    "         x_header-generictrp, x_header-trtxgkpos.",
    "  IF tvdir-bastab EQ space  OR maintview <> viewname.",
    "* get Table dd25v inhalt of ViewVariant. XB, int4434083 2001",
    "    CALL FUNCTION 'DDIF_VIEW_GET'",
    "      EXPORTING",
    "        name     = viewname",
    "        langu    = sy-langu",
    "      IMPORTING",
    "        dd25v_wa = w_vc_dd25v",
    "*   TABLES",
    "*     DD26V_TAB           =",
    "*     DD27P_TAB           =",
    "*     DD28J_TAB           =",
    "*     DD28V_TAB           =",
    ".",
    "* view- and table-variants",
    "* customauth of view empty -> take customauth of roottab \"HCG 13.11.02",
    "    IF w_dd25v-customauth IS INITIAL.",
    "      CALL FUNCTION 'DDIF_TABL_GET'",
    "        EXPORTING",
    "          name          = mview_roottab",
    "          langu         = sy-langu",
    "        IMPORTING",
    "          dd02v_wa      = dd02v_roottab",
    "        EXCEPTIONS",
    "          illegal_input = 1",
    "          OTHERS        = 2.",
    "      IF sy-subrc <> 0.",
    "        MESSAGE e029 WITH text_table_name RAISING table_not_found.",
    "      ENDIF.",
    "      MOVE dd02v_roottab-contflag TO w_dd25v-customauth.",
    "    ENDIF.",
    "    MOVE: w_vc_dd25v-ddtext     TO x_header-ddtext,",
    "          w_dd25v-customauth TO x_header-customauth,",
    "          w_dd25v-authclass  TO x_header-authclass,",
    "          mview_roottab    TO x_header-roottab,",
    "*         Pflegstatus von Viewcluster in Header schreiben, XB.",
    "          w_vc_dd25v-viewgrant  TO x_header-existency.",
    "*   Pflegestatus darf nur verschärft werden !",
    "    IF tvdir-bastab EQ space AND maintview <> viewname.",
    "* Vari auf View",
    "      SELECT viewgrant FROM dd25v INTO orig_viewgrant",
    "                              WHERE viewname = maintview.",
    "        EXIT.",
    "      ENDSELECT.",
    "      IF sy-subrc = 0.",
    "        IF orig_viewgrant = 'R' OR",
    "           ( ( orig_viewgrant = 'U' OR orig_viewgrant = 'M' ) AND",
    "              w_dd25v-viewgrant  = space ).",
    "          x_header-existency = orig_viewgrant.",
    "        ENDIF.",
    "      ENDIF.",
    "    ENDIF.                             \"Vari for view",
    "* Fill selection criteria (still variants)",
    "***********************************************************************",
    "    IF NOT dd28v_tab[] IS INITIAL.",
    "      MOVE 'X' TO x_header-selection.",
    "      MOVE 'X' TO sel.",
    "      LOOP AT dd28v_tab.",
    "        IF dd28v_tab-tabname NE old_tabname OR",
    "           dd28v_tab-fieldname NE old_fieldname.",
    "          MOVE: dd28v_tab-tabname TO old_tabname,",
    "                dd28v_tab-fieldname TO old_fieldname.",
    "          LOOP AT dd27p_tab WHERE tabname EQ dd28v_tab-tabname",
    "                              AND fieldname EQ dd28v_tab-fieldname.",
    "            EXIT.",
    "          ENDLOOP.",
    "          MOVE sy-subrc TO rc.",
    "        ENDIF.",
    "        CHECK rc EQ 0.",
    "        MOVE: dd27p_tab-viewfield TO sellist-viewfield,",
    "              dd27p_tab-viewfield TO viewfields_key-fieldname,",
    "              x_header-maintview  TO viewfields_key-tabname,\"Subviews",
    "              sy-langu            TO viewfields_key-langu,",
    "              'X' TO sellist-ddic.",
    "        READ TABLE viewfields WITH KEY viewfields_key.",
    "        IF sy-subrc NE 0.",
    "          CLEAR viewfields_key-langu.  \"Langu field possibly empty  \"HCG",
    "          READ TABLE viewfields WITH KEY viewfields_key.",
    "          IF sy-subrc NE 0.\"HCG Better to read any language than nothing",
    "            viewfields_key_s-tabname = viewfields_key-tabname.",
    "            viewfields_key_s-fieldname = viewfields_key-fieldname.",
    "            READ TABLE viewfields WITH KEY viewfields_key_s.",
    "          ENDIF.              \"HCG HW690816 Customer Message 436839 2003",
    "        ENDIF.",
    "        IF dd28v_tab-constants(1) EQ hk.",
    "* literal",
    "*Changed by ACHACHADI on 14 Nov 2008",
    "          IF strlen( dd28v_tab-constants+2(*) ) EQ 0 .",
    "            ASSIGN space TO <hf>.",
    "          ELSEIF dd28v_tab-constants+1 CA hk.",
    "            ASSIGN dd28v_tab-constants+1(sy-fdpos) TO <hf>.",
    "          ELSE.",
    "            ASSIGN dd28v_tab-constants+1(viewfields-outputlen) TO <hf>.",
    "          ENDIF.",
    "        ELSEIF dd28v_tab-constants CO ' +-0123456789'.",
    "* number",
    "          ASSIGN dd28v_tab-constants(viewfields-outputlen) TO <hf>.",
    "        ELSE.",
    "* field name",
    "          ASSIGN (dd28v_tab-constants) TO <hf>.",
    "        ENDIF.",
    "        MOVE: dd28v_tab-negation  TO sellist-negation,",
    "              dd28v_tab-and_or    TO sellist-and_or,",
    "              dd28v_tab-operator  TO sellist-operator.",
    "        IF viewfields-inttype EQ 'C' AND viewfields-convexit EQ space.",
    "          MOVE <hf> TO sellist-value. CLEAR sy-subrc.",
    "        ELSE.",
    "          dummyvalue = <hf>.",
    "          CALL FUNCTION 'VIEW_CONVERSION_OUTPUT'",
    "            EXPORTING",
    "              value_intern  = dummyvalue",
    "              inttype       = viewfields-inttype",
    "              datatype      = viewfields-datatype",
    "              decimals      = viewfields-decimals",
    "              convexit      = viewfields-convexit",
    "              sign          = viewfields-sign",
    "              outputlen     = viewfields-outputlen",
    "              intlen        = viewfields-intlen",
    "            IMPORTING",
    "              value_extern  = sellist-value",
    "            EXCEPTIONS",
    "              error_message = 1.",
    "          IF sy-subrc NE 0.            \"may be external format used?",
    "            MOVE <hf> TO sellist-value. iflag = 'X'.",
    "          ENDIF.",
    "          CALL FUNCTION 'VIEW_CONVERSION_INPUT'",
    "               EXPORTING",
    "                    value_extern   = sellist-value",
    "                    inttype        = viewfields-inttype",
    "                    datatype       = viewfields-datatype",
    "                    decimals       = viewfields-decimals",
    "                    convexit       = viewfields-convexit",
    "                    sign           = viewfields-sign",
    "                    outputlen      = viewfields-outputlen",
    "                    intlen         = viewfields-intlen",
    "                    lowercase      = viewfields-lowercase",
    "*                   DYNP_FIELDNAME = ' '",
    "                    no_status_set  = 'X'",
    "               IMPORTING",
    "                    value_intern   = dummyvalue",
    "               EXCEPTIONS",
    "                    error_message = 1.",
    "          IF sy-subrc NE 0 AND iflag EQ space. \"try original again...",
    "            MOVE <hf> TO sellist-value.",
    "            CALL FUNCTION 'VIEW_CONVERSION_INPUT'",
    "                 EXPORTING",
    "                      value_extern   = sellist-value",
    "                      inttype        = viewfields-inttype",
    "                      datatype       = viewfields-datatype",
    "                      decimals       = viewfields-decimals",
    "                      convexit       = viewfields-convexit",
    "                      sign           = viewfields-sign",
    "                      outputlen      = viewfields-outputlen",
    "                      intlen         = viewfields-intlen",
    "                      lowercase      = viewfields-lowercase",
    "*                   DYNP_FIELDNAME = ' '",
    "                      no_status_set  = 'X'",
    "                 IMPORTING",
    "                      value_intern   = dummyvalue",
    "                 EXCEPTIONS",
    "                      error_message = 1.",
    "          ENDIF.",
    "          CLEAR iflag.",
    "        ENDIF.",
    "        IF sy-subrc EQ 0.",
    "          APPEND sellist.",
    "        ENDIF.",
    "      ENDLOOP.",
    "    ENDIF.",
    "  ELSE.",
    "* table or view but no variant",
    "    MOVE: dd02v-ddtext    TO x_header-ddtext,",
    "          dd02v-contflag  TO x_header-customauth.",
    "  ENDIF.                               \"Subviews ..",
    "* length and offset info",
    "***********************************************************************",
    "  IF x030l-flagbyte O vim_clidep. MOVE 'X' TO x_header-clidep. ENDIF.",
    "  x_header-tablen = maint_x030l-tablen.",
    "* include alignment for character fields",
    "  PERFORM get_aligned_offset_char USING x_header-tablen",
    "                                  CHANGING x_header-after_tabc.",
    "  x_header-keylen = maint_x030l-keylen.",
    "  PERFORM get_aligned_offset_char USING x_header-keylen",
    "                                  CHANGING x_header-after_keyc.",
    "  IF x_header-keylen GT max_trsp_keylen.",
    "    x_header-generictrp = '$'.",
    "    x_header-maxtrkeyln = vim_max_trsp_keylength",
    "                          * cl_abap_char_utilities=>charsize",
    "                          - cl_abap_char_utilities=>charsize.",
    "    x_header-trgkeypos = vim_max_trsp_keylength",
    "                          * cl_abap_char_utilities=>charsize",
    "                          - cl_abap_char_utilities=>charsize.",
    "    IF x_header-genertxtrp EQ space.",
    "      x_header-genertxtrp = x_header-generictrp.",
    "      x_header-maxtrtxkln = x_header-maxtrkeyln.",
    "      x_header-trtxgkpos  = x_header-trgkeypos.",
    "    ENDIF.",
    "  ENDIF.",
    "* texttables",
    "  MOVE text_tab_exists TO x_header-texttbexst.",
    "  IF text_tab_exists NE space.",
    "    MOVE: text_x030l-tablen TO x_header-texttablen,",
    "          text_x030l-keylen TO x_header-textkeylen,",
    "          text_table_name TO x_header-texttab,",
    "          dd02v_txt-masterlang TO x_header-orig_lang.",
    "    PERFORM get_aligned_offset_char USING    x_header-texttablen",
    "                                    CHANGING x_header-aft_txttbc.",
    "    PERFORM get_aligned_offset_char USING    x_header-textkeylen",
    "                                    CHANGING x_header-aft_txtkc.",
    "    IF x_header-textkeylen GT max_trsp_keylen.",
    "      x_header-genertxtrp = '$'.",
    "      x_header-maxtrtxkln = vim_max_trsp_keylength",
    "                            * cl_abap_char_utilities=>charsize",
    "                            - cl_abap_char_utilities=>charsize.",
    "      x_header-trtxgkpos = vim_max_trsp_keylength",
    "                           * cl_abap_char_utilities=>charsize",
    "                           - cl_abap_char_utilities=>charsize.",
    "    ENDIF.",
    "    IF tvdir-bastab = 'X' AND text_x030l-flagbyte O vim_clidep.",
    "      MOVE 'X' TO x_header-textclidep.",
    "    ENDIF.",
    "  ENDIF.",
    "* Fill X_NAMTAB",
    "**********************************************************************",
    "  LOOP AT viewfields.",
    "    index = sy-tabix.                  \"Subviews ..",
    "    CLEAR hidden_field.",
    "* variants",
    "**********************************************************************",
    "    IF maintview <> viewname.    \"überprüfen, ob Feld im Subview ist",
    "      IF tvdir-bastab = 'X'.",
    "        x_header-fieldorder = 'X'.",
    "        IF text_tab_exists <> space AND viewfields-keyflag = 'X' AND",
    "           viewfields-tabname = text_table_name.",
    "          hidden_field = 'T'. CLEAR dd27p_tab.",
    "        ELSE.",
    "          READ TABLE dd27p_tab WITH KEY tabname = viewfields-tabname",
    "                                      fieldname = viewfields-fieldname.",
    "        ENDIF.",
    "      ELSE.",
    "        READ TABLE dd27p_maint INDEX index.",
    "        CHECK dd27p_maint-viewfield = viewfields-fieldname.",
    "        READ TABLE dd27p_tab WITH KEY tabname = dd27p_maint-tabname",
    "                                      fieldname = dd27p_maint-fieldname.",
    "      ENDIF.",
    "      IF hidden_field = space AND sy-subrc = 0.",
    "       READ TABLE viewfields_save WITH KEY tabname = dd27p_tab-viewname",
    "                                        fieldname = dd27p_tab-viewfield.",
    "      ENDIF.",
    "      IF hidden_field = space.",
    "        IF sy-subrc <> 0.              \"Feld nicht in Subview",
    "          IF text_tab_exists = space OR",
    "             viewfields-tabname <> text_table_name.",
    "            x_header-fieldorder = 'X'.",
    "            hidden_field = 'X'. CLEAR dd27p_tab.",
    "          ENDIF.",
    "        ELSEIF sy-tabix <> index.",
    "          x_header-fieldorder = 'X'.  \"andere Feldreihenfolge in Subview",
    "        ENDIF.",
    "      ENDIF.",
    "    ELSEIF tvdir-bastab = space.",
    "      READ TABLE dd27p_tab INDEX index.",
    "      CHECK dd27p_tab-viewfield = viewfields-fieldname.",
    "    ENDIF.                             \".. Subviews",
    "    CLEAR date_fld.",
    "* addresses",
    "**********************************************************************",
    "    IF ( viewfields-domname EQ vim_adrnbr_domains-dom1 OR",
    "         viewfields-domname EQ vim_adrnbr_domains-dom2 ) AND",
    "       hidden_field EQ space AND objh-objhasaddr NE space.",
    "      x_header-adrnbrflag = 'O'.       \"old addresses",
    "    ELSEIF viewfields-domname EQ vim_adrnbr_domains-dom3 AND",
    "       hidden_field EQ space AND objh-objhasaddr NE space.",
    "      x_header-adrnbrflag = 'N'.       \"new addresses",
    "    ENDIF.",
    "* time dependency",
    "**********************************************************************",
    "    IF viewfields-domname EQ vim_delim_date_domain.",
    "      IF viewfields-rollname EQ vim_begdate_dtel1 OR",
    "         viewfields-rollname EQ vim_begdate_dtel2 OR",
    "         viewfields-rollname EQ vim_begdate_dtel3 OR",
    "         viewfields-rollname EQ vim_begdate_dtel4.",
    "        date_fld = 'B'.",
    "        IF viewfields-keyflag NE space.",
    "          TRANSLATE x_header-delmdtflag USING ' ?%B'.",
    "        ELSE.",
    "          TRANSLATE x_header-delmdtflag USING ' $*E'.",
    "        ENDIF.",
    "      ELSEIF viewfields-rollname EQ vim_enddate_dtel1 OR",
    "             viewfields-rollname EQ vim_enddate_dtel2 OR",
    "             viewfields-rollname EQ vim_enddate_dtel3 OR",
    "             viewfields-rollname EQ vim_enddate_dtel4.",
    "        date_fld = 'E'.",
    "        IF viewfields-keyflag NE space.",
    "          TRANSLATE x_header-delmdtflag USING ' *$E'.",
    "        ELSE.",
    "          TRANSLATE x_header-delmdtflag USING ' %?B'.",
    "        ENDIF.",
    "      ENDIF.",
    "    ENDIF.",
    "* long texts",
    "**********************************************************************",
    "    IF viewfields-domname EQ vim_scrform_domain AND",
    "       hidden_field EQ space.",
    "      x_header-scrfrmflag = 'X'. \"sepcial functions for sapscript forms",
    "    ENDIF.",
    "* GUIDs",
    "**********************************************************************",
    "    IF viewfields-domname IN guid_domains.",
    "      x_header-guidflag = 'X'.",

    "* generic transport necessary?",
    "**********************************************************************",
    "    IF viewfields-keyflag NE space AND  \"Keyfelder sind nie auszublenden",
    "       viewfields-inttype NA vim_char_inttypes.",
    "* key contains non-character fields =>",
    "* set x_header-generictrp: 'X': key contains non-characters",
    "*                          ' ': no generic transport",
    "*                          '$': x_header-keylen > vim_max_trsp_keylength",
    "      IF tvdir-bastab EQ space OR",
    "         viewfields-tabname NE text_table_name.",
    "* view or table",
    "        IF x_header-generictrp CO ' $'.",
    "          x_header-generictrp = 'X'.",
    "          x_header-maxtrkeyln = x_namtab-position + x_namtab-flength.",
    "          maxtr_tmp = vim_max_trsp_keylength              \"HCG HW744851",

    "                    - cl_abap_char_utilities=>charsize.",
    "          IF x_header-maxtrkeyln > maxtr_tmp. \"no value > 120 *charsize",
    "            x_header-maxtrkeyln = maxtr_tmp.",
    "          ENDIF.",
    "          IF x_header-maxtrkeyln LT 0.",
    "            x_header-maxtrkeyln = 0.",
    "          ENDIF.",
    "          x_header-trgkeypos = x_header-maxtrkeyln.",
    "          IF tvdir-bastab EQ space. \" OR maintview <> viewname.\"Subviews",
    "* view",
    "            x_header-genertxtrp = x_header-generictrp.",
    "*            x_header-maxtrtxkln = x_header-maxtrkeyln + 1.  \"language",
    "*            x_header-trtxgkpos  = x_header-trgkeypos  + 1.  \"language",
    "          ENDIF.",
    "        ENDIF.",
    "      ELSE.",
    "* texttable",
    "        IF x_header-genertxtrp CO ' $'.",
    "          x_header-genertxtrp = 'X'.",
    "          IF x_namtab-texttabfld NE space.",
    "            x_header-maxtrtxkln = x_namtab-position + x_namtab-flength.",
    "            maxtr_tmp = vim_max_trsp_keylength            \"HCG HW744851",
    "                    * cl_abap_char_utilities=>charsize",
    "                    - cl_abap_char_utilities=>charsize.",
    "           IF x_header-maxtrtxkln > maxtr_tmp. \"no value > 120 *charsize",
    "              x_header-maxtrtxkln = maxtr_tmp.",
    "            ENDIF.",
    "            IF x_header-maxtrtxkln LT 0.",
    "              x_header-maxtrtxkln = 0.",
    "            ENDIF.",
    "          ENDIF.",
    "          x_header-trtxgkpos = viewfields-offset.",
    "          IF x_header-trtxgkpos LT 0.",
    "            x_header-trtxgkpos = 0.",
    "          ENDIF.",
    "        ENDIF.",
    "      ENDIF.",
    "    ENDIF.                             \"viewfields-keyflag NE space",
    "    MOVE: viewfields-fieldname  TO x_namtab-viewfield,",
    "          viewfields-keyflag    TO x_namtab-keyflag,",
    "          viewfields-domname    TO x_namtab-domname,",
    "          viewfields-rollname   TO x_namtab-rollname,",
    "          viewfields-lowercase  TO x_namtab-lowercase,",
    "          viewfields-outputlen  TO x_namtab-outputlen,",
    "          viewfields-intlen     TO x_namtab-flength,",
    "          viewfields-inttype    TO x_namtab-inttype,",
    "          viewfields-datatype   TO x_namtab-datatype,",
    "          viewfields-offset     TO x_namtab-position,",
    "          viewfields-decimals   TO x_namtab-decimals,",
    "          viewfields-sign       TO x_namtab-sign,",
    "          viewfields-leng       TO x_namtab-leng,",
    "          viewfields-convexit   TO x_namtab-convexit,",
    "          viewfields-memoryid   TO x_namtab-memoryid,",
    "          viewfields-reftable   TO x_namtab-reftable,",
    "          viewfields-reffield   TO x_namtab-reffield,",
    "          viewfields-reptext    TO x_namtab-reptext,",
    "          viewfields-scrtext_s  TO x_namtab-scrtext_s,",
    "          viewfields-scrtext_m  TO x_namtab-scrtext_m,",
    "          viewfields-scrtext_l  TO x_namtab-scrtext_l.",
    "    IF maintview <> viewname AND hidden_field = space.",
    "* variant",
    "      IF viewfields_save-scrtext_l NE space.",
    "        MOVE viewfields_save-scrtext_l TO x_namtab-scrtext.",
    "      ELSEIF viewfields_save-scrtext_m NE space.",
    "        MOVE viewfields_save-scrtext_m TO x_namtab-scrtext.",
    "      ELSEIF viewfields_save-scrtext_s NE space.",
    "        MOVE viewfields_save-scrtext_s TO x_namtab-scrtext.",
    "      ELSEIF viewfields_save-reptext NE space.",
    "        MOVE viewfields_save-reptext TO x_namtab-scrtext.",
    "      ELSEIF viewfields_save-fieldtext NE space.",
    "        MOVE viewfields_save-fieldtext TO x_namtab-scrtext.",
    "      ELSE.",
    "        MOVE viewfields_save-fieldname TO x_namtab-scrtext.",
    "      ENDIF.",
    "    ELSE.",
    "* table or view",
    "      IF viewfields-scrtext_l NE space.",
    "        MOVE viewfields-scrtext_l TO x_namtab-scrtext.",
    "      ELSEIF viewfields-scrtext_m NE space.",
    "        MOVE viewfields-scrtext_m TO x_namtab-scrtext.",
    "      ELSEIF viewfields-scrtext_s NE space.",
    "        MOVE viewfields-scrtext_s TO x_namtab-scrtext.",
    "      ELSEIF viewfields-reptext NE space.",
    "        MOVE viewfields-reptext TO x_namtab-scrtext.",
    "      ELSEIF viewfields-fieldtext NE space.",
    "        MOVE viewfields-fieldtext TO x_namtab-scrtext.",
    "      ELSE.",
    "        MOVE viewfields-fieldname TO x_namtab-scrtext.",
    "      ENDIF.",
    "    ENDIF.                                                  \"Subviews",
    "    IF viewfields-checktable NE '*'.",
    "      MOVE viewfields-checktable TO x_namtab-checktable.",
    "      IF x_namtab-checktable EQ space.",
    "        SELECT SINGLE * FROM dd01l WHERE as4local EQ 'A'",
    "                              AND domname  EQ x_namtab-domname.",
    "        IF dd01l-entitytab  NE space.",
    "          MOVE dd01l-entitytab TO x_namtab-checktable.",
    "        ELSEIF dd01l-valexi NE space.",
    "          MOVE dom_value_tab TO x_namtab-checktable.",
    "        ENDIF.",
    "      ENDIF.",
    "    ELSE.",
    "      CLEAR x_namtab-checktable.",
    "    ENDIF.",
    "*** Notlösung Anfang",
    "    IF x_namtab-checktable NE dom_value_tab AND",
    "       x_namtab-checktable CP 'DD*'.",
    "      CLEAR x_namtab-checktable.",
    "    ENDIF.",
    "*** Notlösung Ende",
    "    IF tvdir-bastab EQ space OR maintview <> viewname.",
    "      IF tvdir-bastab EQ space.",
    "        x_namtab-bastabname = dd27p_tab-tabname.",
    "        x_namtab-bastabfld  = dd27p_tab-fieldname.",
    "      ENDIF.",
    "      IF hidden_field = 'X'. dd27p_tab-rdonly = 'H'. ENDIF. \"Subviews ..",
    "      IF maintview <> viewname.",
    "        IF tvdir-bastab = space.                            \"View",
    "          CASE dd27p_maint-rdonly.",
    "            WHEN hidden. dd27p_tab-rdonly = hidden.",
    "            WHEN rdonly.",
    "              IF dd27p_tab-rdonly <> hidden.",
    "                dd27p_tab-rdonly = rdonly.",
    "              ENDIF.",
    "            WHEN subset.",
    "              IF dd27p_maint-keyflag = 'X'.",
    "                dd27p_tab-rdonly = subset.",
    "              ENDIF.",
    "          ENDCASE.",
    "        ELSE.                           \" TVDIR-BASTAB = 'X' ->  Tabelle",
    "          IF dd27p_tab-rdonly = subset.",
    "            CLEAR dd27p_tab-rdonly.",
    "          ENDIF.",
    "        ENDIF.",
    "      ENDIF.                           \".. Subviews",
    "      MOVE dd27p_tab-rdonly TO x_namtab-readonly.",
    "      CASE dd27p_tab-rdonly.",
    "        WHEN rdonly.",
    "          MOVE 'X' TO x_header-rdonlyflag.",
    "        WHEN usrexi.",
    "          MOVE 'X' TO x_header-usrexiflag.",
    "        WHEN hidden.",
    "          MOVE 'X' TO x_header-hiddenflag.",
    "          IF date_fld EQ 'B'.          \"current field is date field",
    "            IF other_date_hidden EQ 'E'. \"other date is also hidden",
    "              TRANSLATE x_header-delmdtflag USING 'B E '.",
    "              CLEAR other_date_hidden.",
    "            ELSE.",
    "              TRANSLATE other_date_hidden USING ' B'.",
    "            ENDIF.",
    "          ELSEIF date_fld EQ 'E'.      \"current field is date field",
    "            IF other_date_hidden EQ 'B'. \"other date is also hidden",
    "              TRANSLATE x_header-delmdtflag USING 'B E '.",
    "              CLEAR other_date_hidden.",
    "            ELSE.",
    "              TRANSLATE other_date_hidden USING ' E'.",
    "            ENDIF.",
    "          ENDIF.",
    "      ENDCASE.",
    "      IF tvdir-bastab = space AND                           \"Subviews",
    "         dd27p_tab-rdonly EQ subset AND dd27p_tab-keyflag NE space AND",
    "                                       \"echtes Subset-Feld",
    "         ( maintview = viewname OR dd27p_maint-rdonly EQ subset ).",
    "      \"Subviews: Pflegedialog muß ebenfalls Subset-Eingenschaft besitzen",
    "        MOVE: 'X' TO x_header-selection,",
    "              'X' TO sel,",
    "              'X' TO x_header-subsetflag.",
    "* modify sellist",
    "        new_line_in_sel = 'X'.",
    "        LOOP AT sellist WHERE viewfield = dd27p_tab-viewfield.",
    "          MOVE index TO sellist-tabix.",
    "          IF sellist-value EQ space.  \"CG: Must always be set, if value",
    "            sellist-initial = 'X'.    \" of selcond in ddic is space.",
    "          ENDIF.",
    "          IF",
    "          ( sellist-negation EQ space AND sellist-operator EQ 'EQ' ) OR",
    "           ( sellist-negation EQ 'NOT' AND sellist-operator EQ 'NE' ).",
    "            CLEAR new_line_in_sel.",
    "*            IF sellist-value EQ space.",
    "*              sellist-initial = 'X'.",
    "*            ENDIF.",
    "          ENDIF.",
    "          MOVE ddic_subset TO sellist-ddic.",
    "          MODIFY sellist.              \"INDEX SY-TABIX.",
    "        ENDLOOP.",
    "        IF new_line_in_sel <> space.",
    "* add entry with initial value for subsetfield",
    "          DESCRIBE TABLE sellist LINES ix.",
    "          IF ix NE 0.",
    "            READ TABLE sellist INDEX ix.",
    "            MOVE 'AND' TO sellist-and_or.",
    "            MODIFY sellist INDEX ix.",
    "          ENDIF.",
    "          MOVE: dd27p_tab-viewfield TO sellist-viewfield,",
    "                subset              TO sellist-ddic,",
    "                space               TO sellist-negation,",
    "                space               TO sellist-and_or,",
    "                equ                 TO sellist-operator,",
    "                index               TO sellist-tabix,",
    "                space               TO sellist-initial,",
    "                space               TO sellist-value.",
    "          APPEND sellist.",
    "        ENDIF.",
    "      ELSE.                            \"kein echtes Subsetfeld",
    "        IF sel NE space.",
    "          LOOP AT sellist WHERE viewfield EQ x_namtab-viewfield.\"Subview",
    "            MOVE index TO sellist-tabix.",
    "            IF sellist-value EQ space.",
    "              sellist-initial = 'X'.",
    "            ENDIF.",
    "            MODIFY sellist.",
    "          ENDLOOP.",
    "        ENDIF.",
    "      ENDIF.",
    "    ENDIF.                             \"Subviews ..",
    "    IF tvdir-bastab = 'X'.             \".. Subviews",
    "      IF text_tab_exists NE space.",
    "        IF viewfields-tabname EQ text_table_name.",
    "          MOVE 'X' TO x_namtab-texttabfld.",
    "        ELSE.",
    "          CLEAR x_namtab-texttabfld.",
    "        ENDIF.",
    "      ENDIF.",
    "      x_namtab-bastabname = viewfields-tabname.",
    "      x_namtab-bastabfld  = viewfields-fieldname.",
    "    ENDIF.                             \"TVDIR-BASTAB eq space",
    "    IF tvdir-bastab EQ space AND viewfields-keyflag NE space.",
    "      LOOP AT roottabfields WHERE keyflag NE space",
    "                              AND fieldname EQ dd27p_tab-fieldname.",
    "        MOVE roottabfields-position TO x_namtab-primtabkey.",
    "      ENDLOOP.",
    "      IF sy-subrc NE 0.",
    "        CLEAR x_namtab-primtabkey.",
    "      ENDIF.",
    "    ELSE.",
    "      CLEAR x_namtab-primtabkey.",
    "    ENDIF.",
    "    APPEND x_namtab.",
    "  ENDLOOP.",
    "**********************************************************************",
    "  IF maintview <> viewname.            \"Subviews ..",
    "    viewfields[] = viewfields_save[].",
    "  ENDIF.                               \".. Subviews",
    "  TRANSLATE x_header-delmdtflag USING '* $ % ? '.",
    "  IF text_tab_exists NE space.",
    "    x_header-sprasfield = langufield.",
    "    READ TABLE textfields WITH KEY fieldname = langufield.",
    "    x_header-sprasfdpos = textfields-offset.",
    "    IF tvdir-bastab NE space.",
    "* table: text table positions",
    "**********************************************************************",
    "      LOOP AT dd05m_tab_txt.",
    "        LOOP AT x_namtab ASSIGNING <namtab>",
    "                         WHERE texttabfld NE space",
    "                           AND keyflag NE space  \"text tab keyfld",
    "                           AND viewfield EQ dd05m_tab_txt-forkey.",
    "          MOVE: dd05m_tab_txt-primpos TO <namtab>-primtabkey,",
    "                sy-tabix TO counter.",
    "*          MODIFY x_namtab.",
    "        ENDLOOP.",
    "        SUBTRACT x030l-fldcnt FROM counter.",
    "        READ TABLE x_namtab INDEX dd05m_tab_txt-primpos",
    "         ASSIGNING <namtab>.",
    "        IF sy-subrc EQ 0.",
    "          MOVE counter TO <namtab>-primtabkey.",
    "*          MODIFY x_namtab INDEX dd05m_tab_txt-primpos.",
    "        ENDIF.",
    "      ENDLOOP.",
    "      LOOP AT x_namtab ASSIGNING <namtab> WHERE texttabfld NE space.",
    "* all text table fields",
    "       <namtab>-texttabpos = <namtab>-position.       \"SW Texttransl  ..",
    "        IF <namtab>-keyflag NE space AND <namtab>-primtabkey NE space.",
    "* no language key",
    "*          IF x_namtab-primtabkey EQ space. \"language key",
    "*            x_header-sprasfdpos = x_namtab-position.",
    "*          x_header-sprasfield = x_namtab-viewfield.",
    "*          ELSE.",
    "*         auch für Tabellenfelder entspr. Texttabfeldname u. Pos setzen",
    "          READ TABLE x_namtab INDEX <namtab>-primtabkey",
    "           ASSIGNING <namtab2>.",
    "          IF sy-subrc = 0.",
    "            <namtab2>-txttabfldn = <namtab>-viewfield.",
    "            <namtab2>-texttabpos = <namtab>-position.",
    "*            MODIFY x_namtab FROM tmp_namtab INDEX sy-tabix.",
    "          ENDIF.",
    "*          ENDIF.",
    "        ENDIF.                           \".. SW Texttransl",
    "        ADD x_header-after_tabc TO <namtab>-position.",
    "*        MODIFY x_namtab.",
    "      ENDLOOP.",
    "    ELSEIF tvdir-bastab EQ space.",
    "* Views: fieldname and offset in text table           \"SW Texttransl ..",
    "************************************************************************",
    "      CLEAR text_tab_exists.",
    "      LOOP AT x_namtab ASSIGNING <namtab>",
    "                       WHERE keyflag EQ space",
    "                         AND bastabname EQ text_table_name.",
    "        <namtab>-txttabfldn  = <namtab>-bastabfld.",
    "        READ TABLE textfields WITH KEY fieldname = <namtab>-bastabfld.",
    "        <namtab>-texttabpos  = textfields-offset.",
    "*        MODIFY x_namtab.",
    "        IF <namtab>-readonly EQ space OR <namtab>-readonly EQ 'R'.",
    "          text_tab_exists = 'X'.",
    "        ENDIF.",
    "      ENDLOOP.",
    "      IF text_tab_exists NE space.",
    "        LOOP AT dd05m_tab_txt.",
    "          CHECK NOT dd05m_tab_txt-forkey IS INITIAL.",
    "* no generic foreign key relation for current field",
    "          READ TABLE x_namtab WITH KEY",
    "           bastabname = dd05m_tab_txt-checktable",
    "           bastabfld  = dd05m_tab_txt-checkfield.",
    "          IF sy-subrc = 0.",
    "            ix = sy-tabix.",
    "            x_namtab-txttabfldn  = dd05m_tab_txt-forkey.",
    "            READ TABLE textfields WITH KEY",
    "             fieldname = dd05m_tab_txt-forkey.",
    "            x_namtab-texttabpos = textfields-offset.",
    "            MODIFY x_namtab INDEX ix.",
    "          ENDIF.",
    "        ENDLOOP.",
    "        IF x_header-genertxtrp = 'X'.",
    "          LOOP AT textfields WHERE keyflag <> space",
    "           AND inttype NA vim_char_inttypes.",
    "            IF textfields-offset > x_header-sprasfdpos.",
    "              x_header-maxtrtxkln = x_header-maxtrkeyln + 1.",
    "            ELSE.",
    "              x_header-maxtrtxkln = x_header-maxtrkeyln.",
    "            ENDIF.",
    "            x_header-trtxgkpos  = textfields-offset.",
    "            EXIT.",
    "          ENDLOOP.",
    "        ENDIF.",
    "      ELSE.",
    "        LOOP AT x_namtab WHERE txttabfldn <> space.",
    "          CLEAR: x_namtab-txttabfldn, x_namtab-texttabpos.",
    "          MODIFY x_namtab.",
    "        ENDLOOP.",
    "        CLEAR: x_header-sprasfield, x_header-sprasfdpos.",
    "      ENDIF.",
    "    ENDIF. \"table or view",
    "  ENDIF. \"texttab exists",
    "  TRANSLATE: x_header-generictrp USING '$X',",
    "             x_header-genertxtrp USING '$X'.",
    "* get variant if available and requested",
    "  IF variant_for_selection NE space AND",
    "     variant_for_selection NE h0.",
    "    PERFORM get_variant_into_sellist TABLES sellist",
    "                                     USING viewname",
    "                                           variant_for_selection 'X'.",
    "    DESCRIBE TABLE sellist.",
    "    IF sy-tfill GT 0.",
    "      x_header-selection = 'X'.",
    "    ENDIF.",
    "  ENDIF.",
    "  IF x_header-delmdtflag <> space.                          \"SW Import",
    "    PERFORM set_partfrkey_in_header TABLES x_namtab",
    "                                    CHANGING x_header.",
    "  ENDIF.",
    "  APPEND x_header.",
    "*----------------------- Add Switch Framework Infos -------------------",
    "  CALL FUNCTION 'VIEW_GET_SFW_INFO'",
    "    EXPORTING",
    "      viewname                    = viewname",
    "    TABLES",
    "      x_header                    = x_header",

    "      no_switch_entry             = 1",

    "  IF sy-subrc <> 0.",
    "* MESSAGE ID SY-MSGID TYPE SY-MSGTY NUMBER SY-MSGNO",

schemas.name: get_connected_systems
schemas.description: List SAP connection IDs configured in this standalone service. Call first if connectionId unknown. No params.

schemas.name: read_function_module_interface
schemas.description: Read one active function module interface and source through the SAP repository helper. Read-only and allowed for customer or standard function modules. Preserves raw updateTaskMode; updateTask is true for any noninitial update mode, including numeric SAP modes, not only X. Mode validity/meaning is not inferred. Returns a deterministic SHA-256 fingerprint; includeExecutionSupport additionally resolves scalar, flat-structure, and table parameter shapes through DDIC.

schemas.name: patch_function_module_interface
schemas.description: Patch the interface of one existing Z* or Y* function module while preserving its implementation source and function attributes. The interface is written through SAP's own create API RPY_FUNCTIONMODULE_INSERT: it receives the six RS38L parameter tables (RSIMP import, RSEXP export, RSCHA changing, RSTBL tables, RSEXC exceptions, RSFDO parameter documentation), every one a DDIC structure any caller can declare, together with funcname/function_pool/remote_call/short_text and the implementation body, and it writes the parameter tables, the TFDIR binding and the implementation include in one operation. It generates the interface header from those tables itself, so the body handed to it must be the bare statement body - the pre-patch include would leave two FUNCTION headers and two ENDFUNCTION statements. It refuses while a live TFDIR row exists, so the helper first retires the row the way SAP itself does, by setting FREEDATE, and falls back to DELETE FROM tfdir only if that is refused. Crucially it never enters fu_save_function, so it neither deletes the implementation include nor rebuilds a bare frame, and no RFC session termination occurs. Requires helper protocol 2.28. Every earlier route is refused by the tool registry: 2.27 and 2.25 called SAPMS38L's fu_save_function_ext directly, which necessarily ends in fu_save_function - that FORM deletes the implementation include with DELETE REPORT ... STATE 'A' and rebuilds only a bare frame through ed_generate_frame; on w200 2.25 left the module with no source, no TFDIR pool/include and no TADIR row, and 2.27 lost the TFDIR row entirely because the RFC session was terminated inside that call (TH_RES_FREE). 2.26 called only the interface-writing routines, which read module-pool globals that only fu_save_function_ext fills, so nothing was written at all. 2.24 wrote the interface through the FUNCTION_SAVE wrapper, which declares P_RS38L and never uses it - it forwards the global RS38L of SAPLSUNI instead - so a structure handed to it as P_RS38L never reached the save and the transport registration then saw an empty object name. 2.23 and earlier wrote parameter documentation only, so an interface change reported as applied was never written to SAP. The interface change itself is proven on w200: the parameter tables changed and an independent read-back confirmed it. The helper re-reads every table after writing and answers FUNCTION_PATCH_SAVE_NOT_OBSERVED with a per-table difference list if SAP did not store what was sent, or FUNCTION_PATCH_SAVE_REJECTED if the write path tears the module down. The tool still requires the exact parent function group, current interface and implementation-source fingerprints, exact package, existing transport, and DESTRUCTIVE_INTERFACE_CHANGE confirmation for rename, update, or remove, and it verifies that the implementation source is byte-identical afterwards. As on the create path, an add or update of an export parameter cannot ask for optional=true: SAP has no OPTIONAL flag on EXPORTING parameters and the request is refused before SAP is called. SAP locks are never cleared automatically and transports are never created or released.

operationId.description: Caller-generated write operation ID. Reuse is blocked; keep this ID to query recovery status. If omitted, the service generates one for backward compatibility.

expectedInterfaceFingerprint.description: Any fingerprint of the same active function module, as returned by read_function_module_interface: `fingerprint` (whole definition), `interfaceFingerprint` (interface only) or `sourceFingerprint` (implementation only). An implementation-only change leaves interfaceFingerprint untouched.

schemas.name: read_ddic_transparent_table
schemas.description: Read one SAP Dictionary transparent table, including keys, delivery class, technical settings, package, concurrency version, and SHA-256 definition fingerprint. If the object has only a non-active version (for example left behind by an interrupted create), that stored version is returned instead with status 'inactive', active false, its own definitionFingerprint and a resumeTool hint, so the pending definition can be inspected rather than merely reported as blocking. Read-only and allowed for customer or standard objects. A read that completes and finds nothing answers with status "not-found", exists false and authoritative true instead of failing, so a missing object is distinguishable from a broken helper; every other failure is still reported as an error.

schemas.name: create_ddic_transparent_table
schemas.description: Create one new Z* or Y* transparent table whose fields reference active data elements. Existing tables are rejected to avoid destructive database conversion. Key fields must be contiguous at the beginning. A quantity or currency field must also carry referenceTable and referenceField (DD03P-REFTABLE/REFFIELD), because DDIC activation rejects such a field without them; supply both or neither. Requires an existing transportable package and transport; never releases transports.

operationId.description: Caller-generated write operation ID. Reuse is blocked; keep this ID to query recovery status. If omitted, the service generates one for backward compatibility.

schemas.name: append_ddic_transparent_table_fields
schemas.description: Append nullable, non-key direct fields to one existing Z* or Y* transparent table while preserving its Include/Append components and all table settings. New direct fields are inserted before the first Append marker so the extension layout remains intact, and the components that were preserved are declared in layoutComponents. Requires the current version and SHA-256 fingerprint from read_ddic_transparent_table, the exact package, an existing transport, and active data elements. Field removal, rename, type/key/nullability changes, technical-setting changes, automatic retries, and transport release are not supported.

operationId.description: Caller-generated write operation ID. Reuse is blocked; keep this ID to query recovery status. If omitted, the service generates one for backward compatibility.

schemas.name: patch_ddic_transparent_table_fields
schemas.description: Apply explicit remove, rename, or data-element/key/nullability updates to direct fields of one existing Z* or Y* transparent table. Only the direct fields named in changes are editable; every Include and Append component is preserved byte-for-byte, is reported back as layoutComponents, and a change aimed at a component-owned field is refused with COMPONENT_FIELD_NOT_PATCHABLE naming the component, because that field's own definition lives under the component and must be patched through the component's own object. Requires the current version and SHA-256 fingerprint, exact package, existing transport, destructive-schema confirmation, and data-loss acknowledgement. Returns native Dictionary conversion evidence when SAP reports it. Automatic retry/rollback, SAP lock clearing, and transport release are not supported.

operationId.description: Caller-generated write operation ID. Reuse is blocked; keep this ID to query recovery status. If omitted, the service generates one for backward compatibility.

schemas.name: patch_ddic_transparent_table_settings
schemas.description: Patch supported DD09V technical settings of one existing Z* or Y* transparent table while preserving its complete field, Include, and Append layout. Supports data class, manually maintainable size categories 0-4, buffering mode/generic key count, and change logging. Requires a fresh table version/fingerprint, exact package, existing transport, and TECHNICAL_SETTINGS_CHANGE confirmation. Never releases transports or retries automatically.

operationId.description: Caller-generated write operation ID. Reuse is blocked; keep this ID to query recovery status. If omitted, the service generates one for backward compatibility.

schemas.name: search_abap_objects
schemas.description: Search ABAP objects by name pattern. Wildcards: * ?. Custom code: prefix Z* or Y* (Z*ARTICLE*, not *ARTICLE*). Standard SAP: BAPI_*, CL_*, /SAP/*. MANDATORY before code generation: training data outdated - ALWAYS verify objects exist first, read signatures with get_abap_object_lines, then generate. Unverified code WILL fail at runtime. DISCOVERY ONLY - NEVER an existence check: the repository index retains stale entries for deleted objects and this tool keeps listing them (verified: deletes returned absenceVerified=true while three separate objects were still listed, one still listed 40 minutes later). It cannot distinguish a live object from a deleted one, so a hit here does not prove the object exists and a miss does not prove it is gone. To establish existence, read the object itself: get_abap_object_lines or get_abap_object_workspace_uri for source objects, and the matching read_* tool for DDIC objects (for example read_search_help).

schemas.name: get_abap_object_info
schemas.description: Get ABAP object metadata: type, total lines, cache status. Use before retrieving content to understand what kind of object you're dealing with. NOT an existence check: for a deleted object whose stale repository entry survives, this may still return the full metadata block (verified on a deleted search help) or answer with plain 'Could not find ABAP object: <name>. The object may not exist or may not be accessible.' text that carries no metadata fields. The field values do not discriminate either - a live object and a deleted one both report Package: Unknown and Total Lines: 1, so 'Package: Unknown' is NOT a signal that the object is stale. Use get_abap_object_lines or get_abap_object_workspace_uri when you need to know whether an object actually exists.

schemas.name: get_abap_object_lines
schemas.description: Read active ABAP source and return the SHA-256 fingerprint of the complete untrimmed source. objectType disambiguates same-named objects. methodName extracts one method body from a class while retaining the complete-source fingerprint.

schemas.name: search_abap_object_lines
schemas.description: Search text inside ABAP source. Literal or regex (isRegexp=true). objectName wildcards scan multiple objects (max 10). Searches active committed SAP source.

schemas.name: search_bte_dispatchers
schemas.description: Search standard BTE dispatcher function modules by the exact OPEN_FI_PERFORM_<identifier>_E and OPEN_FI_PERFORM_<identifier>_P naming convention. Event and Process searches retain independent availability and extract numeric or alphanumeric identifiers from exact function names. This is dispatcher discovery only; it does not inspect FIBF products, configured handler modules, activation, order, or runtime execution.

schemas.name: read_bte_configuration
schemas.description: Read one exact BTE Event or Process definition plus SAP-application and customer-product handler assignments from FIBF configuration. Returns raw application/product activation flags and does not execute the event, call handlers, or modify configuration.

schemas.name: get_abap_object_workspace_uri
schemas.description: Get a deterministic standalone adt:// URI for an exact ABAP object. All params are mandatory. Function modules are supported with type FUGR/FF. A completed search that matches nothing is returned as a result carrying Status: not-found, Resolved: false and Authoritative: false instead of a tool error: it is a failed lookup, not proof that the object does not exist, because the repository search answers nothing for a type this release cannot search.
